product.name: Marsh Whisspurr W-AVR Acoustic Vibration Reduction Unit
product.description:
The Marsh Whisspurr Acoustic Vibration Reaction (AVR) unit has been designed to limit noise levels and vibrations from diaphragm compressors used in the water and wastewater treatment sectors.
Suitable for all types of compressor including; Bibus Secoh, Nitto and Charles Austen, the Marsh Whisspurr AVR unit is easily fitted inline between the compressor and air diffuser. If space permits, the Marsh Whisspurr unit should be fitted as close as possible to the compressor – preferably, inside the sewage treatment plant.
Please note, the Marsh Whisspurr Acoustic Vibration Reduction unit is chemically sealed and bolted shut, which creates a pressure vacuum when in operation. Any tampering, breaking of the seal, or removal of any bolts will invalidate the warranty and will prevent the unit from working effectively. This unit is also not suitable for side channel blowers.
What are the benefits of the Marsh Whisppurr Acoustic Vibration Reduction unit?
The Marsh Whisspurr Acoustic Vibration Reduction unit’s innovative design ensures that any noise pollution emanating from the compressor unit is dramatically reduced without hindering the overall performance of the treatment system. Rural areas, where continuous noise is a nuisance, particularly benefits from AVR unit’s noise and vibration reduction qualities.
Available in four standard sizes, the corrosion free Marsh Whisspurr AVR unit does not require any electrics and can be easily installed into existing wastewater and water treatment systems.
Features and Benefits

Innovative UK design (patent pending).
Significantly reduces compressor volume and vibration without reducing in air pressure from the compressor.
No increase in back pressure to the compressor.
The unit contains no moving parts and requires no electrics.
Can be easily retrofitted to existing compressors.
Hose tail is 20mm standard.
Ideal for rural areas where noise pollution is a nuisance.
Available in four standard sizes.
Manufactured from resin and glass polymer, making the unit corrosion free and invulnerable to warm/humid conditions.
Unit is dark green as standard.

Specification
Overall unit width: 142mm
Overall unit height (excluding hose tail):200mm240mm350mm450mm
Material (unit): Resin and Glass Polymer
Material (hose tail connections): Brass with Stainless Steel nuts and bolts.
Colour: Dark Green
product.variant_name: Marsh Whisspurr W-AVR Acoustic Vibration Reduction Unit Code W-AVR1

product.name: Marsh Cesspool Cesspit Tank
product.description:
The Marsh cesspool cesspit tank is a covered, watertight unit for storing raw household sewage. It has no outlet and relies on road transport for the removal of raw sewage. No biological treatment is involved.

Heavy duty shell as standard to enable installation in all ground conditions
Integral lifting eyes for improved on-site handling
Unique ‘keying-in’ lip to assist anchoring into granular or concrete surround

Modern environmental regulations either discourage or ban the use of cesspools (Cesspools are not permitted in Scotland), and instead connections to municipal sewage systems or package sewage treatment plants are encouraged or required.In many countries, planning and development regulations for the protection of the environment prevent home-owners who live close to rivers and environmentally sensitive areas from installing a cesspit or septic system, requiring a sewage treatment plant instead.
Please note, whoever empties your cesspool should be a registered Waste Carrier and hold a current discharge licence from the local water authority.

product.name: Marsh Portapurra Temporary Sewage Treatment Plant
product.description:
The portable and compact Portapura sewage treatment tank from Marsh Industries has been specifically designed for temporary accommodation (caravans/travel homes), site offices, site toilets and workshops. The Portapura can be installed above or below ground and treats domestic wastewater to a level that is 25 times better than the recommended EN standard.
What are the benefits of choosing Marsh Portapura?
This compact and portable sewage treatment tank is designed specifically for temporary buildings. Design objectives included performance, running costs, installation, transport and storage, making the Portapura the logical choice for sites where temporary buildings are required.
The Portapura’s compact design provides quick and easy installation (where below ground installation can be achieved in approximately 2 hours) with minimum visual impact on the surrounding landscape as well as simple and safe access for maintenance and cleaning.  Systems can be installed above ground and removed/stored when not in use.
The cost of installing and running the Portapura is minimal when compared to larger, commercial systems making it one of the more cost-effective sewage treatment tanks on the market.
Another benefit of choosing the Portapura sewage treatment tank is its impact on the environment. Being CE?approved to BS EN 12566 with an ammonia result that is 25 times better than the recommended EN standard means the Portapura is well within discharge consent requirements.
Technical

Available in three sizes - 2, 3 or 5 person units (gravity or pumped outlet)
Compact, lightweight construction - No heavy plant required
Portable
Cost effective installation - Below ground installation can be achieved in approximately 2 hours
Outstanding treatment efficiency - 14:19:0.7mg/ltr (BOD:Suspended solids:Ammonia)
Near silent air compressor - Ensures minimal running, maintenance and servicing costs
Electrical consumption: 1.8kWh/d - Equivalent to the daily use of a lightbulb
CE?approved to BS?EN 12566
Fire resistance tested in accordance with EN ISO 11925-2:210
Tested for structural integrity in accordance with EN ISO 179-1/1eA
Neck extensions are available for deeper installations

Do not install a Portapura treatment plant in water logged or uneven ground.
Do not remove the covers of the Portapura, or access the unit in any way, without firstly isolating the mains power.
product.variant_name: Marsh Portapura 2 Person Temporary Sewage Treatment Plant - Gravity

product.description: The Ensign domestic sewage treatment plant comes with lifting eyes to make unloading and installation faster and safer. We designed the Ensign plant to self-level on the base and with our unique pipe connections ensure the installation is undertaken efficiently and correctly. The six person Ensign Sewage plant is extremely strong and is only 1.95m in depth with an inlet invert of 500mm, this design reduces both the time and cost of installation, in normal ground conditions the unit only requires a pea-shingle surround. For guidance ideally the Ensign plant should be 7m from a dwelling or10m from a stream.Package Sewage Treatment Plants (or PSTP's) are often a suitable option where groundwater in the surrounding environment is vulnerable, drainage field percolation values are restrictive, or direct discharge to watercourse or surface water sewer is the preferred discharge method. Marsh Industries Ensign range of sewage treatment plants treat final effluent to British and European Standards to allow it to be discharged back into the watercourse whilst reaching national consent standards. Our tanks can be manufactured with either a gravity or pumped outlet to meet your site requirements. At Marsh Industries we only use 100% virgin resin (no chalk fillers) in all our products. Lead times for Domestic Sewage Treatment Plants are normally only 5-7 working days. Comes with external compressor as standard.Features & Benefits: Marsh Ensign Ultra Advanced Domestic Sewage Treatment PlantNo moving partsLow running and maintenance costsEasy installation with keying-in lip and lifting eyesTested and certified to BSEN12566-350 year design life25 year structural guaranteeThe Ensign plant has been tested to EN12566:3-2005Highest testing standard for European testingThe Ensign can discharge direct to a ditch, watercourse or percolation bedSuitable for One 4 bed residence & Two 3 Bed Residences - 16 People or 25 people working.In addition to anaerobic digestion taking place in the primary settlement chamber the Ensign: Ultra unit allows the clarified water to pass into a second 'aeration' chamber where it is treated to remove the dissolved constituents. Here aerobic bacteria supported by diffused air and mobile media, ensures full treatment is achieved before the treated effluent and 'sloughed off' bacteria flows to a final settlement chamber. The final effluent is then discharged to the drainage field or watercourse via polylok filter.Please note: External Cabinet can be supplied free of charge, please state when ordering.

product.description: With lifting eyes for quick and safe unloading, this Marsh Ensign domestic sewage treatment plant self-levels on the base. With various populations to choose from, you can find the right treatment plant for you.In normal ground conditions, the unit only needs a pea-shingle surround. product.name: Marsh Polylok Commercial Sewage Treatment Plant
product.description:
The plant has low visual impact with unobtrusive lids. Easy access integral separate de-sludge pipe and almost silent running & odour free. Its is manufactured in the united kingdom & is backed with a 25 year structural guarantee. Invert risers and pumped outlets can be supplied for deeper drain connections. Designed with integral recycling system that makes it ideal for intermittent use.
Features

Endogeneous respiration, reducing the sludge and increasing the amount of dissolved oxygen in the primary chamber.
For Increased health and safety we fit our large plants with stabalising feet to protect the civil engineering installation team from being injured because of the movement and roll of the sewage treatment plant.
We fit kiddie-guards into our turrets to prevent either adults, children or animals falling into the plant during maintenance, this is an added assurance to our bolt down covers.
Carbon Vents will be fitted into our manhole covers reducing the need for external venting.
After the process is completed we fit a Polylok Tertiary Filter that reduces further the final suspended solids by 40% and further improves the final BOD.

Warranty & guarantee

The minimum design life of the tank structure is twenty five years. (internally & externally)
The compressor blower is covered by a two year guarantee.
The diffuser is covered by a five year guarantee.
Engineered using high performance materials.
All metal components stainless steel.

product.name: Marsh Non-Return Valve for Underground Sewage System
product.description:
These Marsh non-return valves are for use with the Marsh Underground Sewage Treatment Systems.
They fit either an 110mm pipe or an 160mm pipe.
Non-return valves allow for a flow in only one direction and is fitted to ensure that the flows go through a pipe in the right direction, where pressure conditions may otherwise cause reversed flow.

product.name: Marsh Ensign Pumped Domestic Sewage Treatment Plant
product.description:
The Marsh Ensign Pumped Domestic Sewage Treatment Plant is an effective solution for sewage treatment, designed to accommodate areas where a natural gravity flow is not feasible. By opting for a pumped treatment plant, the system will efficiently direct effluent to higher levels, ensuring an economical and environmentally friendly operation.
When installed correctly, the Marsh Ensign Pumped Domestic Sewage Treatment Plant operates virtually odour-free and near-silently, also offering a discreet design that will not create eyesores in your garden or outdoor spaces. It is recommended Ensign plants are positioned at a minimum distance of seven metres from a dwelling or ten metres from a stream.
Features & Benefits: Marsh Ensign Pumped Domestic Sewage Treatment PlantAn effective and environmentally friendly pumped solution for sewage treatment in areas without gravity flowEfficiently directs effluent to higher levels using a pumpDiscrete design, virtually odour-free and operates near-silentlyFeatures lifting eyes for easy unloading and self-levelling on the base for easy installationUnique pipe connections for efficient and cost-effective installationTreats effluent to British and European Standards25-year structural guarantee
Featuring lifting eyes, this treatment plant facilitates quick and safe unloading, while its self-levelling capability on the base ensures ease of installation. The unique and innovative pipe connections enable efficient and cost-effective installation, catering to various property sizes.
The Ensign range of sewage treatment plants excels in treating final effluent to both British and European Standards, meeting national consent standards for discharge into watercourses. Manufactured with 100% virgin resin, excluding chalk fillers, this plant prioritises sustainability. It has undergone rigorous testing, adhering to the highest European testing standard, EN12566:3-2005, enabling direct discharge to ditches, watercourses, or percolation beds.
Standards & CertificationEuropean Standard: EN 12566 3-2005
Please note: External Cabinet as standard. Fitted with an internal pumped outlet and will do a max head of 3m and 50m pumped distance. Outlet is 32mm MDPE.

product.name: Marsh:Standard Commercial Sewage Treatment Plant
product.description:
Marsh:Standard sewage treatment plants are a cost-effective way of treating sewage and wastewater in an off-mains area. For large residential, commercial and industrial sites, including leisure sites, Marsh:Standard sewage treatment plants will provide biological processing for effluent until it’s of a quality well within the British Water effluent standard.
This sewage treatment plant will provide effluent treatment for up to 85 people. Manufactured in the UK, the tank is made from GRP virgin unfilled resin to provide a durable and structurally secure tank that has consistent wall thickness and no fillers in the material. Built this way in part as a safety feature, Marsh:Standard plants also have turret guards and failure alarms for extra peace of mind.
A low energy compressor and high specification bacteria keep the Marsh:Standard sewage treatment plant running smoothly as the bacteria along with membrane diffusers ensure the circulation of effluent so that it’s all treated. The low energy compressor minimises running costs whilst the system needs minimal maintenance as the system itself has no moving parts.
Approved to BS12566, the heavy duty shell provides a long life for Marsh:Standard sewage treatment plants. Alarms and 600mm lockable manhole covers are as standard.

product.name: Lindab Magestic Round Galvanised Steel Rafter Bracket
product.description:
Lindab Magestic is an improved galvanised steel material for rainwater system and standing seam applications. Magestic offers the same trusted Lindab product designs with a strengthened magnesium zinc alloy coating.
Galvanised steel is already the most environmentally friendly material used in rainwater systems. Magestic has a reduced impact on zinc resources and less than 25% zinc run off into soils compared to hot dipped galvanised steel. New technology has allowed the material to be developed using magnesium to create a stable barrier to protect zinc’s porous structure against corrosion factors. Salt spray tests demonstrate the highest surface protection of any metallic coated steel. Magestic has more than twenty times the corrosion resistance of hot dipped galvanised steel. Unpainted metal gutters naturally weather organically adjusting to the installation environment. Magestic settles to an attractive dark grey metallic appearance within 3-5 years after installation.
Magestic corrosion in not influenced by the chlorine content of the environment. Natural exposure tests demonstrate more than three times the corrosion resistance of standard galvanisation in marine environments. Galvanised coatings migrate to repair red rust on cuts and scratches. Magnesium is more anodic than zinc making the sacrificial properties of Magestic more active than standard galvanisation.
Features

New elite, strengthed magnesium alloy coating
Highest surface protection of any metallic coated steel
Improved performance in coastal environments
Lowest price Lindab Rainwater System
10 Year Warranty

New elite, strengthed magnesium alloy coating

Lindab have put a twist on the box gutter with an innovative new rectangular profile. A round bead on the forward-facing lip of the gutter is typical of Swedish style steel guttering.
Lindab Magestic is an improved galvanised steel material for rainwater system and standing seam applications. Magestic offers the same trusted Lindab product designs with a strengthened magnesium zinc alloy coating.
Galvanised steel is already the most environmentally friendly material used in rainwater systems. Magestic has a reduced impact on zinc resources and less than 25% zinc run off into soils compared to hot dipped galvanised steel. New technology has allowed the material to be developed using magnesium to create a stable barrier to protect zinc’s porous structure against corrosion factors. Salt spray tests demonstrate the highest surface protection of any metallic coated steel. Magestic has more than twenty times the corrosion resistance of hot dipped galvanised steel. Unpainted metal gutters naturally weather organically adjusting to the installation environment. Magestic settles to an attractive dark grey metallic appearance within 3-5 years after installation.
Magestic corrosion in not influenced by the chlorine content of the environment. Natural exposure tests demonstrate more than three times the corrosion resistance of standard galvanisation in marine environments. Galvanised coatings migrate to repair red rust on cuts and scratches. Magnesium is more anodic than zinc making the sacrificial properties of Magestic more active than standard galvanisation.
Lindab Rainline Rectangular Gutter Features and Benefits

140mm size provides 11,000mm2 water carrying area
Contemporary aesthetic
Quick and easy to install
Lowest carbon footprint of any rainwater material
Lightweight but wont crack or split
Inexpensive and virtually maintenance free
11 painted colour options with 15 year warranty
Available in unpainted majestic galvanised finish with 10 year warranty

product.name: Marsh Sump2Drain MDPE Sewage Pump Station - Grinder Pump
product.description: The Marsh Sump2Drain Grinder Twin Pump Station is designed for sites where traditional gravity drainage cannot be installed. Fitted with twin heavy-duty grinder pumps, it macerates sewage into a fine slurry before pumping, enabling discharge through small-bore pipework over long distances or uphill to a sewer, septic tank or treatment plant. The corrosion-resistant MDPE chamber is lightweight and features a moulded keying-in lip for secure concrete anchoring, while the high-level alarm provides added reassurance by warning against high water levels.Ideal for rural properties, basements and challenging installations, the twin pump arrangement ensures reliable operation, even if one fails. And the compact chamber helps keep excavation manageable and offers a practical solution where pipe routes or site levels prevent conventional drainage.Features & Benefits: Marsh Sump2Drain MDPE Sewage Pump Station - Grinder PumpTwin grinder pumps for pressurised small-bore discharge pipeworkSubmersible pump with 50mm solid handling pumpHigh-level alarm includedStandards & CertificationComplies with BSEN752-6 standards.

product.name: Marsh Sump2Drain Sewage Pump Station with 6m Head - Twin Pump
product.description: The Marsh Sump2Drain Sewage Pump Station is a dependable foul water pumping system for properties where wastewater must be lifted to reach the sewer or treatment plant. Made from corrosion-resistant GRP, with a moulded keying-in lip that anchors securely into concrete, the station is supplied as a complete unit with twin pumps so it can operate on an automatic duty/assist cycle to provide dependable performance. And for extra peace of mind, each twin pump model comes with a high-level alarm, essential for monitoring water levels and preventing failure.Suitable for larger domestic properties and light commercial applications, the system collects wastewater from toilets, kitchens, showers and appliances before discharging it safely to the mains sewer, septic tank or treatment plant. The remaining larger soil particles that are blocked from passing through the fabric, bridge against each other on the outer surface of the fabric. Like granular backfill materials, the bridging effect of these soil particles improves the permeability of the native backfill materials immediately surrounding the perforated drainage pipe. It is particularly suited for use in sandy and silty soil conditions.

product.name: Lindab Magestic Round Galvanised Steel Stop End
product.description:
Lindab Magestic is an improved galvanised steel material for rainwater system and standing seam applications. Magestic offers the same trusted Lindab product designs with a strengthened magnesium zinc alloy coating.
Galvanised steel is already the most environmentally friendly material used in rainwater systems. Magestic has a reduced impact on zinc resources and less than 25% zinc run off into soils compared to hot dipped galvanised steel. New technology has allowed the material to be developed using magnesium to create a stable barrier to protect zinc’s porous structure against corrosion factors. Salt spray tests demonstrate the highest surface protection of any metallic coated steel. Magestic has more than twenty times the corrosion resistance of hot dipped galvanised steel. Unpainted metal gutters naturally weather organically adjusting to the installation environment. Magestic settles to an attractive dark grey metallic appearance within 3-5 years after installation.
Magestic corrosion in not influenced by the chlorine content of the environment. Natural exposure tests demonstrate more than three times the corrosion resistance of standard galvanisation in marine environments. Galvanised coatings migrate to repair red rust on cuts and scratches. Magnesium is more anodic than zinc making the sacrificial properties of Magestic more active than standard galvanisation.
Features

New elite, strengthed magnesium alloy coating
Highest surface protection of any metallic coated steel
Improved performance in coastal environments
Lowest price Lindab Rainwater System
10 Year Warranty

product.name: Naylor Land Drain Pipe 50mm Filter Sock Geotextile
product.description: Designed to complement Naylor Land Drain Pipes, this 50mm Filter Sock Geotextile is made from a specially knit fabric, which offers a unique solution by allowing ultra-fine soil particles to effortlessly flow through, joining the perforated pipe. As water flows, these fine particles are efficiently carried away, ensuring optimal drainage performance. What's more, this Filter Sock Geotextile also plays a crucial role in retaining larger soil particles. These particles, unable to pass through the fabric, create a bridging effect on its outer surface. This not only provides additional structural support but also enhances the permeability of the surrounding native backfill materials, mimicking the benefits of granular backfill. This geotextile is especially well-suited for sand and silty soil conditions. This rectangular outlet can be positioned at any point along your gutters to connect to a downpipe, requiring a hole to be created in the gutter. This gutter outlet is quick and easy to install, using flex-fit flaps to be secured without the need for fasteners or silicone, fitting perfectly to your steel painted rectangular gutters. Manufactured from galvanised steel with a 0.6mm thickness, this traditional box profile gutter outlet is available in a range of colours and downpipe diameters to fit and match your 140mm rectangular gutters and downpipes. Suitable for a variety of applications, this gutter outlet is ideal for a range of classic or contemporary buildings. Manufactured from high-quality steel, this gutter outlet is robust, lightweight and long-lasting. With a protective galvanising thick layer of 275g per square metre of zinc and a top coating of coloured polymer grains, this gutter outlet has excellent flexibility and is scratch and corrosion resistant.
Features & Benefits: Lindab Rectangular Steel Gutter Outlet Suitable for traditional or modern buildings  Variety of colours and downpipe diameters available  Cost-effective and affordable  Minimal environmental impact  Resistant to discolouration and UV stable with a high-build polyester powder coating  Resistant to corrosion and vandalism  Low maintenance requirements  Long-lasting with minimal thermal movement  Quick and easy to install
Protected with extra-durable high-build polyester powder coatings, this gutter outlet has an extended life expectancy to an excess of 70 years. With minimal maintenance needs, this gutter outlet requires the occasional top-up with paint for any scratches and is recommended to be cleaned yearly to ensure a long life. UV stabilised, this gutter outlet is resistant to discolouration and has excellent colourfastness.

product.name: Lindab Round Steel Downpipe Conical Bend
product.description:
Conical pipe bends provide a way of overcoming facade features or to offset pipe stacks whilst maintaining the aesthetics of your Lindab Rainline gutter system. The clean lines and conical shape combine to blend in with the system whilst allowing a male/female connection. Male spigot ends of pipes and outlets can fit perfectly in the top of the bend while the bottom fits into a standard pipe.
This bend provides a 70° angle.
Lindab HB polyester painted steel guttering
This system can be used for new buildings and refurbishment projects to match any external decoration. It could also be used as a subtle guttering system and installed in projects where guttering needs to appear discreet. HB polyester painted guttering from the Lindab Rainline collection is coated with a layer of 275g of zinc that won't discolour or rust, meaning this guttering system offers a solution that won't split, leak, shrink or fade.
This modern and cost-effective half round guttering system is low maintenance, requiring only the occasional wipe down. It's the perfect solution for homeowners who don't want the fuss of constant upkeep but would like to install a durable, long-lasting gutter system. Manufactured from lightweight galvanized steel, the gutters and downpipes can be fit flush to the wall in order to avoid people climbing the building.
All guttering in the HB polyester painted Lindab Rainline range comes with a 15-year warranty on the HB polyester painted coating and has a 70-year life expectancy.

Conical pipe bends provide a way of overcoming facade features or to offset pipe stacks whilst maintaining the aesthetics of your Lindab Rainline gutter system. The clean lines and conical shape combine to blend in with the system whilst allowing a male/female connection. Male spigot ends of pipes and outlets can fit perfectly in the top of the bend while the bottom fits into a standard pipe.
This bend provides a 70° angle.
Lindab HB polyester painted steel guttering
This system can be used for new buildings and refurbishment projects to match any external decoration. It could also be used as a subtle guttering system and installed in projects where guttering needs to appear discreet. HB polyester painted guttering from the Lindab Rainline collection is coated with a layer of 275g of zinc that won't discolour or rust, meaning this guttering system offers a solution that won't split, leak, shrink or fade.
This modern and cost-effective half round guttering system is low maintenance, requiring only the occasional wipe down. It's the perfect solution for homeowners who don't want the fuss of constant upkeep but would like to install a durable, long-lasting gutter system. Manufactured from lightweight galvanized steel, the gutters and downpipes can be fit flush to the wall in order to avoid people climbing the building.
All guttering in the HB polyester painted Lindab Rainline range comes with a 15-year warranty on the HB polyester painted coating and has a 70-year life expectancy.

product.name: Lindab Leafline Gutter Brush
product.description:
Available in 3 metre continuous lengths and in three diameters (100mm, 125mm and 150mm), Leafline is easy to install. Simply place one or more in your guttering; they even bend around corners. No special tools or training are required and it only takes a matter of minutes. The leafline gutter brush is virtually indestructible, made of stainless steel wire core with polypropylene bristles, so it will be years before you have to think about this problem again.
Features

Prevents leaves and debris build-up in guttering.
Stops birds and rodents entering loft spaces.
Easily fitted in minutes, even around corners.
Virtually indestructible and maintenance free.
Suitable for most domestic gutters.
Cost-effective.

This extra-durable, high-build polyester paint coating provides protection, extending the life expectancy of this downpipe bend to an excess of 70 years with low maintenance requirements. product.name: Lindab Round Steel One Piece Offset
product.description:
The steel painted round one-piece offset by Lindab is used to 'offset' a pipe stack, joining the gutter outlet or to traverse a plinth. Available with a fixed 100mm projection. Lindab’s round one-piece offset is smart and low-maintenance thanks to resilient, scratch-resistant polyester paint. It also comes with UV stability which means the colour can last for years to come. The Lindab one-piece offset is part of the popular Rainline™ range. Rainline is a sustainable range that has been tested and proven to offer the lowest carbon footprint rainwater system of any competitor. It is manufactured from 30% recycled material and is totally recyclable, meaning the environmental impact of steel is minor compared to plastic or other material. Manufacturing materials used in RainlineTM also means lasting solutions with systems being able to last up 70 years. 
Features & Benefits: Lindab Round Steel One Piece Offset SOKN one-piece offset with fixed 100mm projectionLow environmental impact over its lifetime than other metalsManufactured from 30% recycled material for easy recyclingUV stability helps minimise colour fadingLow maintenance saving time and costsHigh resistance to corrosion and vandalismCost-effective with a 15-year warranty as part of the Rainline™ painted systems range
Please note: 15-year warranty does not apply to unpainted finishes. Use of the Lindab steel painted one-piece offset in coastal regions where salt water is present is also not advised as it can risk a corrosive reaction. In this instance, a coated system should be used.

The steel painted round one-piece offset by Lindab is used to 'offset' a pipe stack, joining the gutter outlet or to traverse a plinth. Available with a fixed 100mm projection. Lindab’s round one-piece offset is smart and low-maintenance thanks to resilient, scratch-resistant polyester paint. It also comes with UV stability which means the colour can last for years to come. The Lindab one-piece offset is part of the popular Rainline™ range. Rainline is a sustainable range that has been tested and proven to offer the lowest carbon footprint rainwater system of any competitor. It is manufactured from 30% recycled material and is totally recyclable, meaning the environmental impact of steel is minor compared to plastic or other material. Manufacturing materials used in RainlineTM also means lasting solutions with systems being able to last up 70 years. 
Features & Benefits: Lindab Round Steel One Piece Offset SOKN one-piece offset with fixed 100mm projectionLow environmental impact over its lifetime than other metalsManufactured from 30% recycled material for easy recyclingUV stability helps minimise colour fadingLow maintenance saving time and costsHigh resistance to corrosion and vandalismCost-effective with a 15-year warranty as part of the Rainline™ painted systems range
Please note: 15-year warranty does not apply to unpainted finishes. Use of the Lindab steel painted one-piece offset in coastal regions where salt water is present is also not advised as it can risk a corrosive reaction. In this instance, a coated system should be used.

product.name: Lindab Square Steel Large Water Hopper

Part of Lindab's rainwater systems range, this hopper is suitable for when a standing seam is installed on the roof. Manufactured using powder-coated galvanised steel with 0.6mm thickness, this hopper has been carefully developed to pair with pre-coated material. So there is no contrast in design when it comes to fitting full systems together. Moreover, by opting for steel, this is a lighter material than cast iron and easier to handle than aluminium. product.name: Lindab Magestic Rectangular Galvanised Steel Regular Water Hopper
product.description:
Lindab Magestic is an improved galvanised steel material for rainwater system and standing seam applications. Magestic offers the same trusted Lindab product designs with a strengthened magnesium zinc alloy coating.
Galvanised steel is already the most environmentally friendly material used in rainwater systems. Magestic has a reduced impact on zinc resources and less than 25% zinc run off into soils compared to hot dipped galvanised steel. New technology has allowed the material to be developed using magnesium to create a stable barrier to protect zinc’s porous structure against corrosion factors. Salt spray tests demonstrate the highest surface protection of any metallic coated steel. Magestic has more than twenty times the corrosion resistance of hot dipped galvanised steel. Unpainted metal gutters naturally weather organically adjusting to the installation environment. Magestic settles to an attractive dark grey metallic appearance within 3-5 years after installation.
Magestic corrosion in not influenced by the chlorine content of the environment. Natural exposure tests demonstrate more than three times the corrosion resistance of standard galvanisation in marine environments. Galvanised coatings migrate to repair red rust on cuts and scratches. Magnesium is more anodic than zinc making the sacrificial properties of Magestic more active than standard galvanisation.
Features

New elite, strengthed magnesium alloy coating
Highest surface protection of any metallic coated steel
Improved performance in coastal environments
Lowest price Lindab Rainwater System

product.name: Lindab Steel Downpipe Self Cleaning Leaf Trap
product.description:
Self cleaning leaf filter in HD polythene for down pipes.
When it comes to creating beautiful, environmentally friendly and maintenance free buildings, using the right materials is everything. The Lindab Rainline Steel Rainwater system uses the very best in lightweight galvanised steel to create a contemporary, cost effective and eco-friendly guttering system that won't shrink, split or leak and looks great too.
Each piece of core steel is coated with 275g zinc per square metre, a naturally self-healing coating that won't discolour or rust. The coating on both our High Build Polyester and Aluzinc guttering systems, are guaranteed for 15 years with a life expectancy in excess of 70 years.
Rainline is ideal for modern and traditional buildings for both refurbishments and new build projects. Gutters and downpipes simply push together without the need for any special tools or sealants.
The SLS fits directly into a 110mm Drain point, simply slides inside.
When you have a different diameter downpipe entering the SLS from above, you will need to purchase a BUTK drain shoe which allows for this connection to be achieved.
Properties

Steel is the ultimate material for roof-drainage systems.
It is much lighter than cast iron, is easier to handle than aluminium and offers minimal thermal movement compared to plastic (which can move and crack causing leaks).
Lindab's steel also has the lowest CO2 impact of any competitor.

Low maintenance

The only maintenance required is an occasional wipe or wash down.
Easy assembly and installation guarantee a long service life.

Vandal resistant

Highly resistant to attack from vandals - can be fixed flush to a wall to prevent anyone climbing up the downpipe

Minimum environmental impact

Tests have proven that Rainline steel systems reflect the lowest cradle-to-grave impact by minimizing the use of raw materials, components, energy, packaging and transport.

Cost-effective solution

Competitively priced against leading plastic systems and inexpensive compared with aluminium and cast iron.

product.name: Lindab Airy AIRYB Vent Valve (Body Only)
product.description: Designed for wall or ceiling installation in new-builds or as an upgrade replacement, the Airy AIRYB Vent Valve by Lindab helps improve your indoor climate. It features a smart grip function which ensures easy installation, plus unique sound performance that ensures optimum sound level. The valve consists of two parts, the valve body (AIRYB) and the flat front plate (AIRYFP - sold separately). product.name: Lindab 210mm Half Round Copper Rafter Bracket
product.description:
A limited range of Rainline products are available in uncoated copper. The finish is highly desirable and provides excellent corrosion resistance once it has transitioned to a greenish verdigris patina.
Rainline is ideal for modern and traditional buildings for both refurbishments and new build projects. Gutters and downpipes simply push together without the need for any special tools or sealants.
Low maintenance

The only maintenance required is an occasional wipe or wash down.

Vandal resistant

Highly resistant to attack from vandals - can be fixed flush to a wall to prevent anyone climbing up the downpipe.

Cost-effective solution

Competitively priced against leading plastic systems and inexpensive compared with aluminium and cast iron.

Quick and easy to install

Lindab's smart design solutions saves installation time for professionals and makes DIY installation easy. The pipes simply push together, snap mounting outlets, self-sealing stop ends, and click lock gutter joints and pipe brackets are just some of the unique product features of Lindab Rainline.

product.name: Harmer SML Cast Iron Underground Drain Pipe
product.description: This Harmer SML Cast Iron Underground Drain Pipe is part of a sturdy and flexible dry-jointed pipework system that is easy to install and suited to various applications. It is lightweight yet durable, making it resistant to accidental external damage and vandalism, and eco-friendly with a recyclable cast iron structure.With a choice of ductile or stainless steel couplings, the complete soil and waste pipework system covers installation from pipework connection to stack to underground sewer connection. It is compatible with rainwater installations alongside Harmer Roof Outlets with pipes in lengths of 3m and diameters ranging from 50mm to 400mm. You can construct your system using the twin screw couplings. Socketless fixing between pipe and fittings is easy but secure without special installation equipment.Features & Benefits: Harmer SML Cast Iron Underground Drain PipeLightweight but strong cast ironHigh tensile strengthEasily assembled with socketless fixingResilient primer and epoxy coatings for low maintenanceRecyclable after useSystem suited to various applicationsThe pipes and fittings from this system are crafted from grey iron to DIN 1691 (exceeds BS 1452 Grade 150 ISO 185 Grade 15), while the couplings feature stainless steel and ductile cast iron constructions. The pipes are coated with a primer (minimum thickness of 40 µm) on their exteriors and an epoxy coating (minimum thickness of 120 µm) on their interiors. Fittings, however, are coated both externally and internally with an epoxy coating (minimum thickness 60 µm). product.name: Freefoam 10mm Square Edged Cappit uPVC Fascia Board 2.5m
product.description: Available in a range of fascia widths and a variety of colours and woodgrain finishes, this Square Leg Cap Over fascia has a clean, modern style and ensures a professional and neat installation. product.name: Freeflow Deepflow Plastic Gutter Running Outlet
product.description:
From Freefoam's innovative Freeflow rainwater systems with deep round style gutters, this running outlet is ideal for connecting your gutters to your downpipes and is made from high-quality uPVC ensuring a high flow capacity which is suitable for steep or large roofs and areas prone to high precipitation levels.Co-extruded with a white interior and a range of colours to choose from for the exterior, this running outlet decreases heat absorption and consequential thermal movement which reduces the risk of any issues such as leaks or damage through splitting or cracking. product.name: Freeflow Half Round Plastic Gutter
product.description:
Freeflow is a range of innovative, high quality PVC-U rainwater systems that are the result of Freefoam’s culture of continuous innovation and investment in research and development. The Freeflow range has been designed to ensure both reliable, leak-free performance and quick installation. In addition, it is compatible with other rainwater systems with a range of adaptors. Freeflow products come in a range of standard colours including white, black and brown.
Each rainwater system is co-extruded with a white interior and a range of exterior colours - Freefoam’s new innovative solution to the problems associated with rapid heat absorption and expansion of gutters. Widely published test results show that while a white surface exposed to sunshine can absorb heat and attain a surface temperature 10ºC or more over the air temperature, dark surfaces can rise a further 30-40ºC and exceed the softening point of the PVC. On large capacity gutters with a large surface area facing the sun, this can be a particular problem. While the interior will be exposed to sunlight as normal, its absorption of heat from the sun and subsequent expansion along its width and length will be significantly reduced, thus dramatically decreasing the probability of any associated problems.

product.name: Freeflow Square Style Plastic Gutter External Stopened
product.description:
The Freeflow square line gutter system includes a traditional square style gutter with a complete range of matching fittings to ensure a water-tight professional installation. The gutter is 114mm wide, 57mm deep and is available in lengths of 4m and 5m. All square line gutter system parts are available in white, black and brown. The square line gutter is compatible with other square line rainwater systems with a range of adaptors. Square or round pipe systems may be fitted to the square line gutter system.Freeflow is a range of innovative, high quality PVC-U rainwater systems that are the result of Freefoam’s culture of continuous innovation and investment in research and development. The Freeflow range has been designed to ensure both reliable, leak-free performance and quick installation. In addition, it is compatible with other rainwater systems with a range of adaptors. Freeflow products come in a range of standard colours including white, black and brown.
Each rainwater system is co-extruded with a white interior and a range of exterior colours - Freefoam’s new innovative solution to the problems associated with rapid heat absorption and expansion of gutters. Widely published test results show that while a white surface exposed to sunshine can absorb heat and attain a surface temperature 10ºC or more over the air temperature, dark surfaces can rise a further 30-40ºC and exceed the softening point of the PVC. On large capacity gutters with a large surface area facing the sun, this can be a particular problem. While the interior will be exposed to sunlight as normal, its absorption of heat from the sun and subsequent expansion along its width and length will be significantly reduced, thus dramatically decreasing the probability of any associated problems.

product.name: Freeflow Plastic Ogee Gutter Angle
product.description: These Freeflow ogee gutter angles are part of a solid and dependable traditional-style gutter system with modern materials and plenty of practical selling points. product.name: Freeflow Plastic Ogee Gutter Internal Stopend
product.description:
The Freeflow ogee gutter system includes a traditional ‘s’ curved style gutter with a complete range of matching fittings to ensure a water-tight professional installation. An additional benefit for customers is the symmetrical shape of the ogee gutter which eliminates the need to stock a range of left and right hand parts. The gutter is 135mm wide, 77mm deep and is 4m long. All ogee gutter system parts are available in white, black, brown and caramel. Square or round pipe systems may be fitted to the ogee gutter system.Freeflow is a range of innovative, high quality PVC-U rainwater systems that are the result of Freefoam’s culture of continuous innovation and investment in research and development. The Freeflow range has been designed to ensure both reliable, leak-free performance and quick installation. In addition, it is compatible with other rainwater systems with a range of adaptors. Freeflow products come in a range of standard colours including white, black and brown.
Each rainwater system is co-extruded with a white interior and a range of exterior colours - Freefoam’s new innovative solution to the problems associated with rapid heat absorption and expansion of gutters. Widely published test results show that while a white surface exposed to sunshine can absorb heat and attain a surface temperature 10ºC or more over the air temperature, dark surfaces can rise a further 30-40ºC and exceed the softening point of the PVC. On large capacity gutters with a large surface area facing the sun, this can be a particular problem. While the interior will be exposed to sunlight as normal, its absorption of heat from the sun and subsequent expansion along its width and length will be significantly reduced, thus dramatically decreasing the probability of any associated problems.

The Freeflow range has been designed to ensure both reliable, leak-free performance and quick installation. In addition, it is compatible with other rainwater systems with a range of adaptors. Freeflow products come in a range of standard colours including white, black and brown.
Each rainwater system is co-extruded with a white interior and a range of exterior colours - Freefoam’s new innovative solution to the problems associated with rapid heat absorption and expansion of gutters. Widely published test results show that while a white surface exposed to sunshine can absorb heat and attain a surface temperature 10ºC or more over the air temperature, dark surfaces can rise a further 30-40ºC and exceed the softening point of the PVC. On large capacity gutters with a large surface area facing the sun, this can be a particular problem. While the interior will be exposed to sunlight as normal, its absorption of heat from the sun and subsequent expansion along its width and length will be significantly reduced, thus dramatically decreasing the probability of any associated problems.

product.name: Graf Carat Garden Comfort Rainwater Harvester Package
product.description: Designed for outdoor cleaning and irrigation purposes, the Garden Comfort Rainwater Harvesting system by Graf is ideal for collecting rainwater from the roof of your property and then feeding it into the underground tank via the downpipes. Available in various sizes, you can use the harvester for domestic or commercial use with the choice of either an A15 lid for pedestrian use or a B125 cast iron lid for light vehicular use.Before entering the underground tank, the water passes through a filter to remove debris, ensuring clear water for use. An underground pressure-sensitive pump is also installed. When a valve or tap is opened, the water is pumped under pressure until the valve is closed allowing the system to re-pressurise and turn off the power to the pump.Features & Benefits: Graf Carat Garden Comfort Rainwater Harvester PackageLightweight for easy handling and transportationEasy and safe to assembleA15 and B125 lid options and choice of harvester sizes availableEPDM used to profile sealings and ensure minimum life of 25 yearsConstant monitoring of production ensures consistent qualitySuitable for vehicle loading when a telescopic cast iron cover is usedTwo additional hose-lock connection extraction pointsFilter prevents leaves, moss and debris from travelling with the rainwater out of the tankFilter package 2 consists of an internal Universal Filter 3, an inflow stilling system for controlling the water inflow as well as a Spannfix connection sleeve, Rodent Guard and an Overflow siphon. The Integra Inox Submersible pump features an automatic start/stop function with a floating water extraction unit and protection against dry running.Please note: If you have an above-ground tank, you can use a pump to extract the rainwater. However, if the tank is underground, you'll need a pump to extract the rainwater. It's important to consider what you'll be using the harvested rainwater for, as this will determine whether you need a backup function for periods where little rainwater is collected.

product.name: Graf Klaro E Professional Sewage Treatment Plant
product.description:
Klaro E Professional sewage treatment plants by Graf are always a good choice. They are flexibly adapted to meet the stricter discharge values in water protection areas. No live parts need to be installed in the Klaro E Professional. Movement processes are created by three air lift pumps that are operated using a compressor which is built into the control.
The Graf Klaro E Professional wastewater treatment system does not need consistent integration of live technology in the tank. Klaro E Professional sewage treatment plant can be flexibly adjusted to changing conditions by altering the cycle times. The air pressure holes are colour coded to avoid installation errors; the whole system just needs to be fitted to the baffle of the reservoir.
Graf Klaro E Professional Sewage Treatment Plant Features & Benefits

No live technology in the reservoir
Air compressor is very durable and whisper-quiet
Flexible, as expandable
Can be switched to holiday mode
Easy to install
Low maintenance
10-year warranty on sewage reservoirs
2-year warranty on technology

Klaro E Professional sewage treatment plants by Graf are always a good choice. They are flexibly adapted to meet the stricter discharge values in water protection areas. No live parts need to be installed in the Klaro E Professional. Movement processes are created by three air lift pumps that are operated using a compressor which is built into the control.
The Graf Klaro E Professional wastewater treatment system does not need consistent integration of live technology in the tank. Klaro E Professional sewage treatment plant can be flexibly adjusted to changing conditions by altering the cycle times. The air pressure holes are colour coded to avoid installation errors; the whole system just needs to be fitted to the baffle of the reservoir.
Graf Klaro E Professional Sewage Treatment Plant Features & Benefits

No live technology in the reservoir
Air compressor is very durable and whisper-quiet
Flexible, as expandable
Can be switched to holiday mode
Easy to install
Low maintenance
10-year warranty on sewage reservoirs
2-year warranty on technology

product.name: JFC Twinwall Drain Pipe Y Unequal Branch for Surface Water Drainage
product.description: Designed to create a branch from a surface water drainage main line at a 45° angle, JFC Manufacturing's Twinwall drain pipe Y unequal branch is a triple socket section manufactured from HDPE plastic. Manufactured by a twin extrusion process, which means having two layers simultaneously extruded, a strong and durable structure is assured. The process is performed once inside and the other heat welded together in a continuous process. The outer wall is also corrugated for exceptional strength, reducing the potential for on-site damage to occur. As opposed to the inner wall which is smooth with a seamless finish to assist hydraulic flow. Better yet, the modern design means that unlike traditional single-wall pipes it will prevent slit accumulation. Features & Benefits: JFC Twinwall Drain Pipe Y Unequal Branch for Surface Water DrainageLightweight for easy handling and transportation on-siteCan be installed at depths from 0.5 to 10 metresTwin walled and corrugated for strong structureSmooth inner wall supports increased flow capacityCan be combined with a full range of bends of all angles and both equal and unequal junctions are also availableResistant to naturally occurring chemicalsPlant and labour cost reductionEliminates waste compared to traditional pipesEasy to cut to length if requiredThe branch complies with HAPAS Roads and Bridges Agrément Certificate No. 02/H069, is BBA approved and, if installed correctly with three sealing rings, a watertight system is achievable. If it is too long, you can also cut the branch as needed to fit accordingly. Please note: Suitable for surface water drainage only.

product.name: JFC Twinwall Drain Pipe Surface Water Drainage Double Socket Bend
product.description:
HDPE double socket twinwall bends. For use with twinwall pipe to create a rigid bends. If installed with 2 sealing rings a watertight system can be achieved.
For surface water applications only. Complies with HAPAS BBA.
Twin Wall drainage pipe is made from HDPE plastic and is available from 100mm to 3000mm diameters. Manufactured by a twin extrusion process in which two layers are simultaneously extruded, one inside the other and heat welded together in one continuous process. The outer wall is corrugated providing excellent structural strength which reduces the possibility of on-site damage. The inner wall has a smooth seamless finish to assist hydraulic flow. This design, unlike traditional single-wall pipe prevents silt accumulation.
Benefits of Twin Wall include:

Lightweight 6 metre long lengths
Strong (Twin Walled & corrugated)
Smooth inner wall for increased flow capacity
Resistant to naturally occuring chemicals
Can be installed at depths from 0.5 to 10 metres
BBA and HAPAS Roads & Bridges Agrément Certificate No. 02/H069
Reduced plant & labour costs
Faster installation as 6 metre lengths mean fewer joints
Elimination of waste compared to traditional pipe
Pipe is easily cut to size requirements on site
A full range of bends of all angles & both equal & unequal junctions are also available
product.variant_name: JFC Twinwall Drain Pipe 15 Degree Double Socket Bend - 150mm

HDPE double socket twinwall bends. For use with twinwall pipe to create a rigid bends. If installed with 2 sealing rings a watertight system can be achieved.
For surface water applications only. Complies with HAPAS BBA.
Twin Wall drainage pipe is made from HDPE plastic and is available from 100mm to 3000mm diameters. Manufactured by a twin extrusion process in which two layers are simultaneously extruded, one inside the other and heat welded together in one continuous process. The outer wall is corrugated providing excellent structural strength which reduces the possibility of on-site damage. The inner wall has a smooth seamless finish to assist hydraulic flow. This design, unlike traditional single-wall pipe prevents silt accumulation.
Benefits of Twin Wall include:

Lightweight 6 metre long lengths
Strong (Twin Walled & corrugated)
Smooth inner wall for increased flow capacity
Resistant to naturally occuring chemicals
Can be installed at depths from 0.5 to 10 metres
BBA and HAPAS Roads & Bridges Agrément Certificate No. 02/H069
Reduced plant & labour costs
Faster installation as 6 metre lengths mean fewer joints
Elimination of waste compared to traditional pipe
Pipe is easily cut to size requirements on site
A full range of bends of all angles & both equal & unequal junctions are also available
product.variant_name: JFC Twinwall Drain Pipe 90 Degree Double Socket Bend - 450mm

product.name: Freeflow Plastic Square to Round Downpipe Adaptor
product.description:
Freeflow is a range of innovative, high quality PVC-U rainwater systems that are the result of Freefoam’s culture of continuous innovation and investment in research and development. The Freeflow range has been designed to ensure both reliable, leak-free performance and quick installation. In addition, it is compatible with other rainwater systems with a range of adaptors. Freeflow products come in a range of standard colours including white, black and brown.
Each rainwater system is co-extruded with a white interior and a range of exterior colours - Freefoam’s new innovative solution to the problems associated with rapid heat absorption and expansion of gutters. Widely published test results show that while a white surface exposed to sunshine can absorb heat and attain a surface temperature 10ºC or more over the air temperature, dark surfaces can rise a further 30-40ºC and exceed the softening point of the PVC. On large capacity gutters with a large surface area facing the sun, this can be a particular problem. While the interior will be exposed to sunlight as normal, its absorption of heat from the sun and subsequent expansion along its width and length will be significantly reduced, thus dramatically decreasing the probability of any associated problems.
product.variant_name: Square to Round Pipe Adaptor - Freeflow

product.name: Midland Lead Code 7 Cast Lead Roof Flashing
product.description: This roof flashing is crafted from Code 7 lead, a heavier and more robust option designed for applications where high strength and longevity are essential. With an impressive 3.15mm thickness, it provides exceptional resistance to weathering, movement, and creep, making it ideal for demanding roofing details and long-term performance exceeding 100 years. Manufactured by Midland Lead from 100% recycled materials.The lead is produced using a precision machine-casting process, where a rotating, water-cooled drum is dipped into molten lead to create a consistently thick and uniform sheet. Once formed, the lead is lifted cleanly from the drum, rolled into coils, and cut to size, ensuring a premium-quality finish that is easy to handle.Features & Benefits: Midland Lead Code 7 Cast Lead Roof Flashing35.7kg/m² nominal weight3.15mm thicknessMachine castBBA Certificate No. 86/1764100% recyclable and sustainableLasts over 100 yearsWhat is Machine Cast Lead?Both cast and milled lead are fabricated according to the same tolerances, codes, analysis and permitted sizes, however, cast lead outperforms milled lead when comparing the strength and creep resistance. Machine Cast Lead has a clean non-oily finish, which means it's ready to use and be fitted in all weather.Application: flat roofing, pitched roofs, vertical cladding, parapet, box and tapered valley gutters, pitched valley gutters, bay tops & canopies, dormersPlease note: To avoid thermal expansion and contraction issues with lead flashing, individual flashing pieces must not exceed one metre in length. Due to temperature fluctuations, regular spaced expansion joints must be used.

product.name: Graf One2Clean Plus Sewage Treatment Plant
product.description:
The One2Clean Plus sewage treatment plant from Graf will treat the water, so that it is clean enough to be discharged into a water course (depending on how frequently it is being used and the manufacturer’s guidelines). However, One2Clean Plus sewage treatment plants do require a power source and requires emptying approximately every year.
The water discharged from the One2Clean Plus packaged treatment plant must meet the relevant British Standard which is BS EN 12566 for small sewage treatment plants and BS 6297:2007 for drainage fields.
Graf One2Clean Plus Sewage Treatment Plant Process

Untreated waste enters the One2Clean tank via the inlet on the side.
Wastewater then falls directly into the biological zone where the treatment takes place, allowing micro-organisms to start the breakdown process.
Compressed air is used initially for aeration through the diffuser, intermittent to achieve the best treatment performance.
Aeration is then stopped allowing the activated waste to sink to the bottom.
Compressed air is sent through the One2Clean tank once again, extracting the cleaned water near the surface.
This water passes through a sampling point before leaving the plant, where samples can be taken to confirm the quality of effluent.
The above process occurs twice per day, each lasting 12 hours.
The sludge which builds up at the bottom of the tank must also be emptied in line with the manufacturer’s instructions
Numerous companiescan dispose of the waste, these must be a registered waste carrier

Features & Benefits

One tank with just one chamber
Less energy consumption
No mechanical elements in the wastewater
No pumps in the wastewater
No electrical components in the wastewater
Incredibly low volume of sewage sludge
Odourless, clear treated water for extraction
State-of-the-art manufacturing for maximum stability
100% watertight and corrosion-resistant
Can be installed in groundwater
Simple maintenance via an integrated, self-cleaning sampling container
More advanced control panel than the standard One2Clean
Control panel allows additional plug in retro fitting of add on systems

product.name: Midland Lead Code 8 Cast Lead Roof Flashing
product.description: This roof flashing is manufactured from Code 8 lead, the thickest and most heavy-duty option available, specifically designed for projects that demand maximum performance. With a substantial 3.55mm thickness, it offers outstanding resistance to deformation, thermal movement, and long-term wear. Produced by Midland Lead using 100% recycled raw materials, it is a sustainable choice and fully certified by the British Board of Agrément (BBA).Manufactured through a precision machine-casting process, a rotating water-cooled drum is immersed into molten lead, allowing a dense and uniform sheet to form across its surface. The lead is then smoothly lifted from the drum, wound into coils, and cut into manageable rolls.Features & Benefits: Midland Lead Code 8 Cast Lead Roof Flashing40.3kg/m² nominal weight3.55mm thicknessMachine castBBA Certificate No. 86/1764100% recyclable and sustainableLasts over 100 yearsWhat is Machine Cast Lead?Both cast and milled lead are fabricated according to the same tolerances, codes, analysis and permitted sizes, however, cast lead outperforms milled lead when comparing the strength and creep resistance. Machine Cast Lead has a clean non-oily finish, which means it's ready to use and be fitted in all weather.Application: flat roofing, pitched roofs, parapet, box and tapered valley gutters, bay tops & canopies, and dormersPlease note: To avoid thermal expansion and contraction issues with lead flashing, individual flashing pieces must not exceed one metre in length. Due to temperature fluctuations, regular spaced expansion joints must be used.

product.description: Available in a range of diameters and with or without perforations to suit your installation needs, this JFC CorriPipe™ offers the perfect solution for effective surface drainage. Manufactured from high-density polyethylene (HDPE) plastic, this Twinwall Drainage Pipe is a product of precision manufacturing.Through a cutting-edge twin extrusion process, two layers seamlessly intertwine and are heat welded together in a single continuous step, ensuring durability and reliability. The outer layer boasts a corrugated design, enhancing its structural integrity and reducing the risk of on-site damage. Meanwhile, the inner wall features a smooth, seamless finish that optimises hydraulic flow, eliminating the headache of silt accumulation that plagues traditional single-wall pipes.Features & Benefits: JFC Twinwall Drain Pipe for Surface Water Drainage - 6000mmFor surface water drainageManufactured from high-density polyethylene (HDPE) plasticInnovative twin extrusion process ensure durabilityCorrugated outer wall for added structural strengthSmooth inner wall for optimal hydraulic flow and no silt buildupLightweight with a generous 6-metre length for easy installationReduces labour and plant costs with fewer jointsResistant to a wide range of naturally occurring chemicalsSuitable for various soil conditions (depths from 0.5 to 10 metres*)Thanks to its lightweight construction and generous length of 6 metres, this product facilitates a swift and hassle-free installation process. This not only saves you time but also minimises labour and plant costs due to fewer required joints. Plus, its resistance to a wide range of naturally occurring chemicals makes it suitable for various soil conditions. A full range of fittings and accessories are also readily available to complete your drainage system.Please note: *The maximum cover depths for CorriPipe™ are typically between 6 and 10 metres when installed in accordance with series 500 of the MCDHW Volume 1 as detailed in the CorriPipe™ BBA certificate.

product.name: Midland Lead Code 6 Cast Lead Roof Flashing
product.description: This roof flashing is produced from Code 6 lead, delivering outstanding strength with excellent flexibility, and is designed to perform for over a century. It is a sustainable choice, being fully recyclable and manufactured using 100% recycled raw materials, while also holding certification from the British Board of Agrément (BBA).During manufacture, a water-cooled rotating drum is immersed into molten lead, allowing a consistent sheet to form across its surface. The formed lead is then carefully lifted from the drum, wound into coils, and cut into rolls, ensuring a high-quality finish that is ready for practical installation.Features & Benefits: Midland Lead Code 6 Cast Lead Roof Flashing30.1kg/m² nominal weight2.65mm thicknessMachine castBBA Certificate No. 86/1764100% recyclable and sustainableLasts over 100 yearsWhat is Machine Cast Lead?Both cast and milled lead are fabricated according to the same tolerances, codes, analysis and permitted sizes, however, cast lead outperforms milled lead when comparing the strength and creep resistance. Machine Cast Lead has a clean non-oily finish, which means it's ready to use and be fitted in all weather.Application: flat roofing, pitched roofs, vertical cladding, hip and ridge flashing, parapet, box and tapered valley gutters, pitched valley gutters, bay tops & canopies, apron & cover flashings, chimney flashings and dormersPlease note: To avoid thermal expansion and contraction issues with lead flashing, individual flashing pieces must not exceed one metre in length. Due to temperature fluctuations, regular spaced expansion joints must be used.

product.name: Hargreaves Cast Iron H460 Hopper Head
product.description: This standard rainwater head acts as a funnel, collecting and channelling rainwater into the downpipes and drains below. Made from robust, reliable and strong cast iron, this hopper has been tried and tested, withstanding many difficulties such as on-site handling, vandalism and mechanical de-blocking. Flame resistant and non-combustible, this hopper head does not require fire collars or extra lagging etc.Surviving the long life of a building, this hopper head is fully sustainable, made from infinitely recyclable cast iron and unlike plastic will not end up in a landfill. This hopper head is ideal for restoration, conservation, refurbishment and heritage work as well as unique, bespoke and new designs on public, domestic, commercial or industrial buildings. Recommended annual inspections once installed this hopper head has low maintenance needs with remedial action is not usually required. The primed layer provides short-term protection to the surface and creates a barrier to corrosion until it can be overcoated with Polyurethane, Acrylic or Epoxy paint. Made from robust, reliable and strong cast iron, this hopper has been tried and tested, withstanding many difficulties such as on-site handling, vandalism and mechanical de-blocking. Flame resistant and non-combustible, this hopper head does not require fire collars or extra lagging etc.Surviving the long life of a building, this hopper head is fully sustainable, made from infinitely recyclable cast iron and unlike plastic will not end up in a landfill. This hopper head is ideal for restoration, conservation, refurbishment and heritage work as well as unique, bespoke and new designs on public, domestic, commercial or industrial buildings. Recommended annual inspections once installed this hopper head has low maintenance needs with remedial action is not usually required. With good noise dampening properties, this hopper head does not rattle in high winds with very little expansion and contraction in extreme temperatures meaning no clicking or creaking.Features & Benefits: Hargreaves Cast Iron H460 Hopper HeadAvailable in a range of sizes and downpipe diameters with your choice of primed or painted black  Painted black by paint specialists in factory conditions  Primed using dark grey RAL 7024 and can be top coated with Acrylic, Epoxy or Polyurethane paint  Internally and externally painted  Withstanding of heavy weights such as heavy snow or ladders  Minimal maintenance requirements with a long-lasting installation  Excellent noise dampening properties and flame resistant  Made from infinitely recyclable, sustainable cast iron  Cost-effective in the long term  Made to British Standards of BS EN 877, certified by BSi Kitemark No. KM684754, BBA approved 06/4401 and UKCA and CE approvedAvailable in a range of sizes and downpipe diameters to match your downpipes, this hopper head can be painted black or primed. Painted internally and externally, the primed hopper head is coated in a dark grey primer providing a surface for subsequent coats of paint to effortlessly adhere to. The primed layer provides short-term protection to the surface and creates a barrier to corrosion until it can be overcoated with Polyurethane, Acrylic or Epoxy paint. The painted black hopper head provides an excellent paint finish that is vital to longevity and performance and protects the underlying substrate by providing a barrier between the Cast Iron and corroding elements.

product.name: Hargreaves Cast Iron Rectangular Downpipe Side Offset
product.description:
This rectangular downpipe side offset is available in a range of diameters and is compatible with the Hargreaves rectangular pipes and fittings. Made from tried and tested cast iron, this offset is strong, reliable and durable, withstanding the difficulties of on-site handling, vandalism and mechanical de-blocking.With good sound dampening properties, this side offset is also non-combustible requiring no extra lagging, fire collars etc. Manufactured from 100% recyclable cast iron, this side offset is fully sustainable and can withstand the long life of a building and unlike plastic, will not end up in a landfill. Suitable for conservation, heritage, refurbishment and restoration work as well as bespoke, new and unique designs on commercial, industrial, public or domestic buildings, this side offset has low maintenance requirements once installed with annual inspections recommended but remedial action is not usually needed.
Features & Benefits: Hargreaves Cast Iron Rectangular Downpipe Side OffsetAvailable in a range of sizes with your choice of primed or painted black  Primed offset painted using RAL 7024 dark grey and can be top-coated with Epoxy, Acrylic or Polyurethane paint  Internally and externally painted  Low sound levels due to very little expansion and contraction in extreme temperatures, therefore, no clicking or creaking and not rattling in high winds  Durable, reliable and strong cast iron material  Made from sustainable, 100% recyclable cast iron  Made to British Standards of BS EN 877, BBA approved 06/4401 and certified by BSi Kitemark No. KM684754  UKCA and CE approved  Cost-effective with long-lasting, minimal maintenance, fire resistance and good sound dampening properties
With your choice of painted black or primed side offset, this offset is internally and externally painted. The painted offset provides an excellent paint finish which is vital to the longevity and performance of your Cast Iron offset, protecting the underlying substrate by providing a barrier between the Cast Iron and corroding elements and carried out by paint specialists in factory conditions. The primed side offset is coated in a dark grey primer which provides a surface that subsequent coats of paint can effortlessly adhere to, providing temporary protection to the surface and creating a barrier to corrosion until it can be overcoated with Acrylic, Polyurethane or Epoxy paint.

product.name: Hargreaves Cast Iron Rectangular Downpipe Plain Earband
product.description: This cast iron rectangular downpipe plain earband is designed to hold a rectangular downpipe in place against a wall. Due to the number of downpipe sizes available, Hargreaves has made sure their range of earbands comes in a variety of sizes to suit your specific downpipe dimensions. You can also opt for black or primed colour depending on your aesthetic requirements. The cast iron rectangular earband is manufactured to the BS460 standard. By choosing cast iron, you're deciding to use a sustainable and durable material that can withstand a variety of factors. Sustainability means it can be fully recycled after its lifetime use and not 'downcycled' like other materials. For resistance, it is highly resistant to distortion caused by accident or vandalism. The cast iron can also withstand the weight of ladders, storms and heavy snow. With potential longevity lasting over 100 years if installed and maintained correctly. Though maintenance is minimal, occasional painting is required approximately every 10 years. Features & Benefits: Hargreaves Cast Iron Rectangular Downpipe Plain EarbandVariety of colours and sizes to choose fromManufactured to the BS 460 standardCan be fully recycled after its useHigh resistance to distortionCan withstand the weight of ladders, storms and heavy stowPotential lifetime of 100+ years if installed and maintained correctlyOccasional painting required approx. every 10 yearsLow noise operationThe system is also quiet when operating. Low noise levels are thanks to the sound of deadening properties of cast iron and they won't rattle in high winds. When exposed to extreme temperatures this also has very little effect on the expansion and contraction of the material. So no noisy clicking or creaking sounds of the gutter are apparent.

product.name: Hargreaves Cast Iron Rectangular Downpipe Side Bend
product.description:
Rectangular rainwater pipes come in a choice of 100mm x 75mm, 125mm x 70mm, 125mm x 100mm and 150mm x 100mm diameters and in standard lengths of 0.6m, 0.9m, 1.2m and 1.8m. Produced by the vertical cast method which offers uniformity of shape and thickness. The premier standard rainwater range includes 8 gutter profiles in a variety of different sizes with capacities up to 3L per second.
Cast Iron is a sustainable material, this means that after serving the drainage needs of a building for its lifetime it can be fully recycled, not 'downcycled'. Premier pipes are highly resistant to distortion caused by accident or vandalism. Cast iron gutters are able to withstand the weight of ladders, storms and heavy snow. Correctly installed and maintained Premier Systems can last in excess of 100 years with minimal maintenance requirements - occasional painting approximately every 10 years.
Cast iron is very quiet in operation, with low noise levels due to the sound deading properties of cast iron and they wont rattle in high winds. They have very little expansion and contraction in extreme temperatures therefore no noisy clicking or creaking of guttering. All Premier rainwater products are manufactured in accordance with BS460.
Bespoke

Any system can be pre-painted in any RAL colour.
Specialist castings and fabrications can be created to fit the specific requirements of your building.
Ears can be added to any standard fitting.
Hopper heads can be customised with dates or embellishments.

Prices on application please call for details.

product.description:
Cast Iron is a sustainable material. This means that after serving the drainage needs of a building for its lifetime it can be fully recycled, not 'downcycled' produced by the veritcal cast method which offers uniformity of shape and thickness. The Premier standard rainwater range now lncludes 8 gutter profiles in a variety of different sizes with capacities up to 3L per second.Premier pipes are highly resistant to distortion caused by accident or vandalism, the gutters will not bend or sag when subjected to heavy snow and storms. Correctly installed and maintained Premier rainwater systems can last in excess of 100 years. Its also 100% recyclable at the end of its life.Low noise levels due to the sound deadening properties of cast iron. Very little expansion and contraction in extreme temperatures therefore no noisy clicking or creaking of gutters they will also not rattle in high winds.Bespoke

Specialist castings and fabrications can be created to fit the specific requirements of your building
Radius curved gutters can be made to match any standard profile
Hopper heads can be customised with dates of embellishments
Can be made to any RAL colour

Hargreaves Foundry’s cast iron guttering range gives you dependable products that withstand erosion and damage, and can even be recycled. This round downpipe offset bend gives you that classic and useful swan neck shape which helps you connect your guttering outlet to a downpipe that is fixed flush against a wall. Particularly helpful in instances where there is an obstruction to avoid or a large gap to accommodate between either fitting.
