product.name: Hargreaves Cast Iron Round Plain Downpipe
product.description:
Cast Iron is a sustainable material. This means that after serving the drainage needs of a building for its lifetime it can be fully recycled, not 'downcycled' produced by the vertical cast method which offers uniformity of shape and thickness. The Premier standard rainwater range now includes 8 gutter profiles in a variety of different sizes with capacities up to 3L per second.Premier pipes are highly resistant to distortion caused by accident or vandalism, the gutters will not bend or sag when subjected to heavy snow and storms. Correctly installed and maintained Premier rainwater systems can last in excess of 100 years. Its also 100% recyclable at the end of its life.Low noise levels due to the sound deadening properties of cast iron. Very little expansion and contraction in extreme temperatures therefore no noisy clicking or creaking of gutters they will also not rattle in high winds.Bespoke

Specialist castings and fabrications can be created to fit the specific requirements of your building
Radius curved gutters can be made to match any standard profile
Hopper heads can be customised with dates of embellishments
Can be made to any RAL colour

Price on application for these options please call for details.

product.name: Hargreaves Cast Iron Notts OG Gutter External Stopend
product.description: Compatible with the Cast Iron Notts OG rainwater gutters, this external stopend can be used at the end of the gutter run to close off the guttering. Manufactured from reliable, durable and strong cast iron, this stopend has been tried and tested, withstanding multiple difficulties such as vandalism, on-site handling and mechanical de-blocking.This fully sustainable stopend is made from infinitely recyclable cast iron, can survive the long life of a building and will not end up in a landfill like plastic. Suitable for bespoke, unique and new designs as well as conservation, restoration, heritage and refurbishment work on domestic, public, industrial or commercial buildings, this stopend has minimal maintenance requirements. With suggested annual inspections once installed, remedial action is not normally needed. This non-combustible and flame resistant stopend does not require fire collars or extra lagging etc and has good sound dampening properties with minimal expansion and contraction in extreme temperatures and no rattling in high winds.Features & Benefits: Hargreaves Cast Iron Notts OG Gutter External StopendAvailable with your choice of primed or painted black  Painted black in factory conditions by paint specialists  Primed using RAL 7024 dark grey and can be coated with Epoxy, Acrylic or Polyurethane paints  Externally and internally painted  Withstands the weight of ladders or heavy snow  Long-lasting installation with low maintenance requirements  Good noise dampening properties and fire-resistant  Made from sustainable, 100% recyclable cast iron  Cost-effective in the long term  Manufactured to British Standards of BS EN 877, BBA approved 06/4401 and certified by BSi Kitemark No. KM684754  UKCA and CE approvedAvailable in painted black or primed, this stopend is painted internally and externally. The painted black stopend provides a good paint finish which is vital to the performance and longevity of your gutters, protecting the underlying substrate by creating a barrier between the corroding elements and Cast Iron. The primed stopend is coated in a dark grey primer which provides a surface for subsequent coats of paint to easily adhere to. Providing temporary protection to the surface, the primed layer creates a barrier to corrosion until it can be overcoated with Acrylic, Epoxy or Polyurethane paint.

product.name: Hargreaves Cast Iron OG Gutter Union
product.description: Used to join two sections of Cast Iron OG gutters in a range of sizes, this gutter union can be fixed to your fascia board to support the joint. Made from strong, robust and reliable cast iron, this gutter union has been tried and tested, enduring many difficulties such as on-site handling, vandalism and mechanical de-blocking.Made from infinitely recyclable cast iron, this gutter union is fully sustainable, can survive the long life of a building and unlike plastic, will not end up in a landfill. Ideal for unique, new and bespoke designs as well as refurbishment, conservation, restoration and heritage work on commercial, industrial, public or domestic buildings, this gutter union requires minimal maintenance once installed. With recommended annual inspections, remedial action is not normally necessary. This gutter union is flame resistant and non-combustible and does not require extra lagging or fire collars etc. With good sound dampening properties, this gutter union does not rattle in the winds and resists expansion and contraction in extreme temperatures.Features & Benefits: Hargreaves Cast Iron OG Gutter UnionAvailable with your choice of painted black or primed in a range of sizes  Painted black by paint specialists in factory conditions and primed using dark grey RAL 7024 can be coated with Acrylic, Polyurethane or Epoxy paints  Internally and externally painted  Withstanding weight of heavy snow or ladder  Minimal maintenance requirements and long-lasting installation  Fire-resistant and good sound dampening properties  Made from infinitely recyclable, sustainable cast iron  Cost-effective in the long term  Made to British Standards to BS EN 877, BBA certified 06/4401 and approved by BSi Kitemark No. KM684754  UKCA and CE certifiedAvailable in your choice of primed dark grey or painted black, this gutter union has been externally and internally painted. The painted black gutter union ensures a good paint finish which is vital to the longevity and performance of your gutters and protects the underlying surface by creating a barrier between the Cast Iron and corroding elements. The primed gutter union is coated in a dark grey primer, providing a surface for subsequent layers of paint to readily adhere to. Creating a barrier to corrosion as temporary protection, this gutter union can be overcoated with Epoxy, Acrylic or Polyurethane paint.

Made from strong, robust and reliable cast iron, this gutter union has been tried and tested, enduring many difficulties such as on-site handling, vandalism and mechanical de-blocking.Made from infinitely recyclable cast iron, this gutter union is fully sustainable, can survive the long life of a building and unlike plastic, will not end up in a landfill. Ideal for unique, new and bespoke designs as well as refurbishment, conservation, restoration and heritage work on commercial, industrial, public or domestic buildings, this gutter union requires minimal maintenance once installed. With recommended annual inspections, remedial action is not normally necessary. This gutter union is flame resistant and non-combustible and does not require extra lagging or fire collars etc. With good sound dampening properties, this gutter union does not rattle in the winds and resists expansion and contraction in extreme temperatures.Features & Benefits: Hargreaves Cast Iron OG Gutter UnionAvailable with your choice of painted black or primed in a range of sizes  Painted black by paint specialists in factory conditions and primed using dark grey RAL 7024 can be coated with Acrylic, Polyurethane or Epoxy paints  Internally and externally painted  Withstanding weight of heavy snow or ladder  Minimal maintenance requirements and long-lasting installation  Fire-resistant and good sound dampening properties  Made from infinitely recyclable, sustainable cast iron  Cost-effective in the long term  Made to British Standards to BS EN 877, BBA certified 06/4401 and approved by BSi Kitemark No. KM684754  UKCA and CE certifiedAvailable in your choice of primed dark grey or painted black, this gutter union has been externally and internally painted. The painted black gutter union ensures a good paint finish which is vital to the longevity and performance of your gutters and protects the underlying surface by creating a barrier between the Cast Iron and corroding elements. The primed gutter union is coated in a dark grey primer, providing a surface for subsequent layers of paint to readily adhere to. Creating a barrier to corrosion as temporary protection, this gutter union can be overcoated with Epoxy, Acrylic or Polyurethane paint.

product.name: Hargreaves Cast Iron OG Gutter
product.description:
Cast Iron is a sustainable material. This means that after serving the drainage needs of a building for its lifetime it can be fully recycled, not 'downcycled'.Round rainwater pipes in a choice of 65mm, 75mm, 100mm and 150mm diameters and in standard lengths of 0.6m, 0.9m, 1.2m and 1.8m. Produced by the vertical cast method which offers uniformity of shape and thickness. The premier standard rainwater range includes 8 gutter profiles in a variety of different sizes with capacities up to 3L per second.Premier pipes are highly resistant to distortion caused by accident or vandalism. Cast iron gutters are able to withstand the weight of ladders, storms and heavy snow.Correctly installed and maintained Premier Systems can last in excess of 100 years with minimal maintenance requirements - occasional painting approximately every 10 years.Cast iron is very quiet in operation, with low noise levels due to the sound deading properties of cast iron and they wont rattle in high winds. They have very little expansion and contraction in extreme temperatures therefore no noisy clicking or creaking of guttering.All Premier rainwater products are manfactuered in accordance with BS460.Bespoke

Any system can be pre painted in and RAL colour.
Specialist castings and fabrications can be created to fit the specific requirements of your building.
Ears can be added to any standard fitting.
Hopper heads can be customised with dates or embellishments.

Prices on application please call for details.

product.name: Hargreaves Cast Iron Beaded Half Round Gutter External Stopend
product.description: This external stopend fits at the end of a guttering run in order to form a tight seal, and therefore prevent the travelling water from falling out as it ventures through the system. From within Hargreaves Foundry’s beaded half round range of guttering products, this external stopend is made of robust cast iron that, once easily installed, will last the duration of your build – regardless of where it is modern or renovated, as well as public, domestic, commercial, or industrial. With the option of black or primed, you have the opportunity to stick with the sleek and refined heritage style or choose a paint colour to coat your fitting onsite over the pre-applied basecoat. Features & Benefits: Hargreaves Cast Iron Beaded Half Round Gutter External StopendRange of sizes for purchase  Cost-effective and long-lasting  Holds up against corrosion and potential handling damage  100% recyclable and sustainable  Successfully meets British standards (BS 460).

product.description:
Cast Iron is a sustainable material. This means that after serving the drainage needs of a building for its lifetime it can be fully recycled, not 'downcycled'.Round rainwater pipes in a choice of 65mm, 75mm, 100mm and 150mm diameters and in standard lengths of 0.6m, 0.9m, 1.2m and 1.8m. Produced by the vertical cast method which offers uniformity of shape and thickness. Cast iron gutters are able to withstand the weight of ladders, storms and heavy snow.Correctly installed and maintained Premier Systems can last in excess of 100 years with minimal maintenance requirements - occasional painting approximately every 10 years.Cast iron is very quiet in operation, with low noise levels due to the sound deading properties of cast iron and they wont rattle in high winds. They have very little expansion and contraction in extreme temperatures therefore no noisy clicking or creaking of guttering.All Premier rainwater products are manfactuered in accordance with BS460.Bespoke

Any system can be pre painted in and RAL colour.
Specialist castings and fabrications can be created to fit the specific requirements of your building.
Ears can be added to any standard fitting.
Hopper heads can be customised with dates or embellishments.

Cast Iron is a sustainable material. The premier standard rainwater range includes 8 gutter profiles in a variety of different sizes with capacities up to 3L per second.Premier pipes are highly resistant to distortion caused by accident or vandalism. They have very little expansion and contraction in extreme temperatures therefore no noisy clicking or creaking of guttering.All Premier rainwater products are manfactuered in accordance with BS460.Bespoke

Any system can be pre painted in and RAL colour.
Specialist castings and fabrications can be created to fit the specific requirements of your building.

product.name: Hargreaves Cast Iron Half Round Gutter Fascia Bracket
product.description:
Cast Iron is a sustainable material. This means that after serving the drainage needs of a building for its lifetime it can be fully recycled, not 'downcycled'.
Round rainwater pipes in a choice of 65mm, 75mm, 100mm and 150mm diameters and in standard lengths of 0.6m, 0.9m, 1.2m and 1.8m. Produced by the vertical cast method which offers uniformity of shape and thickness. The premier standard rainwater range includes 8 gutter profiles in a variety of different sizes with capacities up to 3L per second.
Premier pipes are highly resistant to distortion caused by accident or vandalism. Cast iron gutters are able to withstand the weight of ladders, storms and heavy snow.
Correctly installed and maintained Premier Systems can last in excess of 100 years with minimal maintenance requirements - occasional painting approximately every 10 years.
Cast iron is very quiet in operation, with low noise levels due to the sound deading properties of cast iron and they wont rattle in high winds. They have very little expansion and contraction in extreme temperatures therefore no noisy clicking or creaking of guttering.
All Premier rainwater products are manfactuered in accordance with BS460.Bespoke

Any system can be pre painted in and RAL colour.
Specialist castings and fabrications can be created to fit the specific requirements of your building.
Ears can be added to any standard fitting.
Hopper heads can be customised with dates or embellishments.

product.name: Hargreaves Cast Iron H16 Moulded Gutter Top Rafter Bracket
product.description: This steel top fixing rafter bracket fully supports the H16 Moulded Cast Iron gutters in a range of sizes.  Painted black by paint specialists in factory conditions, this bracket has been provided with a good paint finish that elongates longevity and performance while protecting the underlying surface and creating a barrier between the steel and corroding elements.Ideal for public, domestic, commercial and domestic buildings, this bracket is suitable for a variety of applications including restoration, refurbishment, conservation and heritage work as well as unique, new and bespoke designs. With minimal maintenance requirements, this bracket is advised to have annual inspections, but remedial action is not normally needed. Made from durable, reliable and strong steel, this bracket is part of a cast iron guttering system that can withstand multiple difficulties including vandalism, on-site handling and mechanical de-blocking. Made from 100% recyclable steel, this bracket is fully sustainable and will not end up in a landfill like plastic. With good sound dampening properties and fire resistance, this bracket has a long life expectancy.Features & Benefits: Hargreaves Cast Iron H16 Moulded Gutter Top Rafter BracketNon-combustible and flame resistant without the need for fire collars or extra lagging etc.  Withstanding of weights such as ladders or heavy snow  Strong, reliable and durable steel material  Good sound dampening properties due to not rattling in high winds and very little expansion and contraction in extreme temperatures meaning no clicking or creaking  Made from infinitely recyclable, sustainable steel  Manufactured to British Standards of BS EN 77, approved by BSi Kitemark No. KM684754 and BBA certified 06/4401  CE and UKCA approved  Cost-effective in the long term  Long-lasting installation with minimal maintenance requirements

product.name: Hargreaves Foundry Cast Iron 100mm Soil Pipe Short Radius Bend
product.description:
Cast Iron is a sustainable material. This means that after serving the drainage needs of a building for its lifetime it can be fully recycled, not 'downcycled'.
Cast Iron Soil pipes in a choice of 50mm, 70mm, 100mm, 150mm, 200mm, 250mm and 300mm diameters and in a standard length of 3m. The Halifax system complies with Bristish and European standard BS EN 877 and provides a complete system of pipes and fittings for the conveyance of waste water and rainwater through a building and as far as the sewer.
The combination of great strength and improved surface coatings on the Halifax Soil and Drain System delivers a fit and forget solution in most installations. This is especially important when pipework is concealed and inaccessible and where maintenance would be disruptive to occupants of the building.
The Max and Connect couplings share a similar single screw design for above ground applications. Both couplings provide the quickest jointing method available on the market today for BS EN 877 above ground systems. Also for installations requiring cast iron couplings to match pipework the Haliface ductile cast iron coupling is available.
Please note, all red Hargreaves Foundry Cast Iron Soil Pipes are non-returnable and cannot be refunded.

product.name: Mira JUMP White Electric Shower
product.description: The Mira Jump White Electric Shower offers versatile installation with up to 36 combinations, making it perfect for replacing existing electric showers in bathrooms, wet rooms, and en-suites. product.name: Hargreaves Foundry Cast Iron 100mm Soil Pipe Single Unequal Branches
product.description:
Cast Iron is a sustainable material. This means that after serving the drainage needs of a building for its lifetime it can be fully recycled, not 'downcycled'.
Cast Iron Soil pipes in a choice of 50mm, 70mm, 100mm, 150mm, 200mm, 250mm and 300mm diameters and in a standard length of 3m. The Halifax system complies with British and European standard BS EN 877 and provides a complete system of pipes and fittings for the conveyance of waste water and rainwater through a building and as far as the sewer.
The combination of great strength and improved surface coatings on the Halifax Soil and Drain System delivers a fit and forget solution in most installations. This is especially important when pipework is concealed and inaccessible and where maintenance would be disruptive to occupants of the building.
Couplings
The Max and Connect couplings share a similar single screw design for above ground applications. Both couplings provide the quickest jointing method available on the market today for BS EN 877 above ground systems. Also for installations requiring cast iron couplings to match pipework the Haliface ductile cast iron coupling is available.
Please note, all red Hargreaves Foundry Cast Iron Soil Pipes are non-returnable and cannot be refunded.

product.description: This stunning Rectangular Walk-In Shower Tray from Nuie combines a striking contemporary style with a low-profile slimline design that makes entering and exiting your shower safe and easy. product.name: Oriflo Orifice 500mm Flow Control Chamber Protected Plate
product.description: The Oriflo Orifice 500mm Flow Control Chamber Protected Plate is an advanced solution for managing water flow while filtering out suspended solids, ensuring improved drainage performance. As part of the Oriflo range, this pre-assembled 500mm diameter chamber features a 100% recycled thermoplastic blok, which forces all water flow through it before reaching the outlet. This innovative design effectively filters out Total Suspended Solids (TSS) as small as 30micrometres (0.03mm), reducing the risk of blockages and maintaining system efficiency. With a capacity to handle flow rates up to 70 L/sec, this chamber offers increased performance when integrated into systems with larger depth head drops.Designed for high-demand applications, this model features a rotational moulded chamber base with 150mm or 225mm Twinwall main channel socket connections for seamless integration into existing drainage networks. The attached basket has a capacity of 17.5kg, making it ideal for developments with surface water runoff of up to 1200m². To maintain peak performance, this unit requires a recommended inspection, emptying, and cleaning schedule based on site conditions. product.name: Geoceptor Bypass Separator
product.description: The Geoceptor Bypass Separator is an advanced water treatment solution designed to effectively remove hydrocarbons, oils, silts, and solids from low-flow surface runoffs. Its unique bypass design ensures efficient filtration, preventing harmful contaminants from entering the surrounding environment. product.name: Alusthetic Aluminium Triple-Seal Recess 21mm Manhole Cover
product.description: This Alusthetic Aluminium Triple-Seal Recess is a lockable, super shallow version cover from EcoGrid. It comprises extruded aluminium with a 3mm galvanised steel bottom plate and reinforcement mesh. As a result, it forms a durable and pedestrian-bearing manhole cover tested to EN124 standards with a 21mm recess for a suitable infill.The recessed manhole cover also comes with three seals: two EPDM seals on the base and a T-rubber seal on the outside frame. The third seal is used to reduce tension between the cover and frame, which prevents dirt build-up and contributes to the manhole cover being odour-proof and waterproof.Features & Benefits: Alusthetic Aluminium Triple-Seal Recess 21mm Manhole CoverLockable, shallow and triple-sealed for extra securityMade from extruded aluminium and with a 3mm galvanised steel bottom plate and reinforcement mesh in the coverSeals prevent dirt build-up and ensure odour-proofing and waterproofing21mm recess for suitable infillThis recessed manhole cover comes with many different internal dimensions*. Make sure you explore the options available to find the right one for your project.Please note: *Manhole cover measurements are taken from the clear opening. product.name: Metal Gutta Zinc Ogee Gutter Internal Corner
product.description:
The internal corner from Zinc Gutta is a vital and essential part of your drainage system. The perfect companion to the larger corners on your property, this component is perfect when used on areas such as bay windows, garden sheds and conservatories. Corner brackets ensure your guttering continues to work as a solid and durable body that transports water efficiently and instantly.
For a secure and reliable fit, it is important that corners are attached to the guttering approximately 150mm from the fitting with a fascia bracket. Manufactured in powerful and vigorous 0.7mm zinc, this part makes for easy installation, while offering a cost-effective and low-carbon-footprint solution.
Please note: One joint must be ordered for each length of gutter, gutter section and corner.

product.name: Metal Gutta Zinc Box Gutter Rafter Bracket
product.description: Zinc Gutta’s roof brackets can easily be fitted to an exposed roof truss as a means of keeping the guttering system firmly fixed and tight. A roof bracket is the common substitution for a fascia board when the latter is impractical. For the most comprehensive installation, secure a bracket either side of a straight piece of gutter and continue to fit them an equal distance apart with 600mm - 800mm centres. Roof brackets are easily adjustable and can be bent and re-shaped using a vice or simply twisted by the installer to fit the desired angle. A straight string line will ensure an evenly spaced and fitted finish.

product.name: Metal Gutta Stainless Steel Round Downpipe Bend
product.description:
The Stainless Gutta bends are a helpful component that can be joined together to form a swan neck. They are used to join up downpipes when your guttering is located too far away from the exterior wall of your property.
Attaching the two bends together sees the dual curve return from the running outlet, around the soffit and then back towards the wall. Installers can be sure of simple push fit installation, which also enables it to be easily maintained and cleaned in the future. The two bends are attached using a made-to-measure piece of downpipe to sit in between the components to guarantee a firm fit.

This pipe insulation (also known as pipe lagging) can be conveniently installed alongside pipes for a range of uses, such as hot and cold water services, refrigerated pipework, ductwork, and chilled water lines.Both flexible and durable, this product is easy to quickly slip over pipes without causing damage to either the insulation or the pipes. Not only does Armaflex pipe insulation help prevent frost on pipes, but it also conserves energy and regulates condensation levels, reducing the risk of costly repair work that could arise from frost or condensation damage. This pipe insulation is also dust and fibre free, and features a vapor barrier built-in during manufacturing, further enhancing energy-saving properties. Built-in anti-microbial protection also reduces growth of mould and bacteria.Features & Benefits: Armacell Armaflex EVO Slit Pipe Insulation 2m Lengths Full BoxAvailable in different sizesProduced using a flexible, closed cell, elastomeric nitrile rubberProvides insulation for pipes in a variety of applicationsBoth flexible and durableHelps to prevent frost on pipes, save energy and regulate condensation levelsDust and fibre freeVapour barrier and anti-microbial protection built-inExcellent fire safety performanceThermal conductivity of 0.034 W/mK at 0C, 0.036 W/mK at 20C and 0.038 W/mK at 40CThis pipe insulation boasts excellent fire safety performance, as it has demonstrated zero surface spread of flame, making it ideal for tackling thermal bridging. Additionally, it provides some acoustic insulation benefits by minimising noise from water and air traveling through pipes.Armaflex pipe insulation is available in 2m lengths, with a range of pipe sizes and wall thicknesses to choose from to ensure the best system for your needs.Standards & CertificationSurface spread of flames: Class 0Fire performance: Class 1Noise reduction: sound absorption coefficient ISO 354: 2003

product.name: JTM 3m Underground Pipe (Plain End/Single Socket)
product.description: This 3000mm Underground Drainage Pipe is a crucial component of a wastewater management system that efficiently handles foul discharge from above-ground drainage systems. Not only does the system excel in functionality, but it also boasts a sleek, modern design that blends seamlessly with your property. Without sharp edges or cumbersome connections, the underground fittings are designed with your convenience in mind.Features & Benefits: JTM 3m Underground Pipe (Plain End/Single Socket)3000mm lengthAvailable in a range of diameters to suit your installation needsPart of an Underground Drainage system for wastewater and foul discharge managementuPVC constructionStrong and durable yet lightweightSuitable for high-temperature waste dischargeQuick and easy to installThe Socketed Underground Pipes feature the latest in blown-end technology, complete with an easy-fit rubber seal secured by a circular plastic insert. This innovative design ensures the seal’s integrity during transit and a flawless connection when it’s time to join the pipes. With double-ribbed seals and recessed sockets, the fittings provide a high-capacity pressure joint, giving you peace of mind about your drainage system’s reliability. The comprehensive range of fittings is perfectly suited to various installations and compatible with Above and Below Ground Drainage Systems.

Push-Fit joint through an innovatively designed seal and snap cap system.Comprehensive range of fittings to suit most installations and which integrate with all Above and Below Ground Drainage Systems. product.name: JTM Underground Single Socket Long Radius Bend
product.description: The Underground Drainage system provides an efficient means of waste water drainage and foul discharge from above ground drainage systems. The range includes a variety of gullies and traps to suit most installations and integrate with above and below ground drainage systems. Manufactured in PVC-U to give a strong and durable product, lightweight and easy to work with. The system is suitable for high temperature waste discharge.Fittings have an aesthetic modern look, are compact in size yet remain within the British Standard specification. Push-Fit joint through an innovatively designed seal and snap cap system.Comprehensive range of fittings to suit most installations and which integrate with all Above and Below Ground Drainage Systems. The Socketed Underground Pipe incorporates the latest blown end technology. The easy fit rubber seal is held in place via a circular plastic insert allowing for retention of the seal in transit and a perfect connection for jointing.All Push-Fit underground fittings have a captive seal and snapcap which are designed to be user-friendly – no sharp edges, and with space restrictions in mind, allow for an easy fit connection. The seal is double ribbed, and the sockets incorporate a recessed area to provide space for the rubber seal to locate as the pipe is inserted, forming a high-capacity pressure joint.

product.name: MDPE Blue Pipe Coil Main Water Supply
product.description:
Manufactured from long-lasting, corrosion-free MDPE, otherwise known as alkathene, this range of pipe coils is ideal for below-ground distribution of potable water. Flexible, lightweight and straightforward to install, they are fully compatible with a wide range of push-fit fittings.
Suitable for use in pipeline rehabilitation installations, this MDPE pipe can also be utilised for open-cut and no-dig applications. With a 2.3mm thick solid wall, it features a colour-coded PE80 light blue exterior and PE80 black inner layer.
Features & Benefits: MDPE Blue Pipe Coil Main Water SupplyIdeal for below-ground potable water mains supply distribution12.5 bar maximum operating pressureManufactured from corrosion-free MDPE for longer lifePE80 blue exterior and PE80 black interiorAvailable in various lengths and diameters2.3mm wall thicknessFully compatible with a wide range of push-fit fittingsLightweight, flexible and straightforward to installComplies with BS EN 12201, WRAS approved and SDR 11-rated
Standards & CertificationBSI approved (Kitemarked) to BS EN 12201-2-2011 + A1-2013Regulation 31 of the Water Supply (Water Quality) Regulations 2000: Approved
Please note: For above-ground water distributions, use black HDPE instead of blue MDPE.If BS 6572 is specified, use BS EN 12201 pipework.

product.name: DeWalt Newark Brown Waterproof Safety Boot
product.description: The high-quality full-grain black leather Newark Black Waterproof Safety Boot from DeWalt is an excellent solution for those jobs that require you to be outside working in all weathers. As well as water resistance, the boot provides exceptional comfort, protection and grip.Featuring a waterproof and breathable Samsung membrane lining, your feet will be kept dry when working in sudden rain showers or general damp conditions. The heel support system and cleated dual-density outsole, made from flexible and abrasion-resistant Thermoplastic Polyurethane (TPU), ensure excellent support and grip.Features & Benefits: DeWalt Newark Brown Waterproof Safety BootA high-quality, water-resistant full-grain black leather safety bootS3 safety ratingProvides exceptional comfort, protection and gripWaterproof and breathable Samsung membrane liningTPU heel support system and cleated dual-density outsole200-joule steel top cap and anti-scuff toe guardSteel midsole to protect against objects puncturing the solePU comfort insole and a thick padded tongue and collarAvailable in various sizesThe safety boot has a 200-joule steel top cap to protect your toes from heavy loads and an anti-scuff toe guard. A protective steel midsole will also protect your feet from objects puncturing the sole and causing potential injury. While safety is always at the forefront, comfort when working is equally important. DeWalt has designed the Newark Black Safety Boot with a PU comfort insole for the soles of your feet and a thick padded tongue and collar that will cushion your ankles.Standards & CertificationEuropean Standard: EN 20345: 2011 S3Slip Resistance: SRCPlease note: This footwear has been tested on clay tiles with a sodium lauryl sulphate solution and meets a minimum Coefficient of Friction (CoF) of 0.32 tested flat and a CoF of 0.28 when tested at the heel.This footwear is also tested on stainless steel with a glycerol solution and meets a CoF of 0.18 when tested flat and 0.13 at the heel.

product.name: Poseidon Liquid Applied Waterproof Membrane
product.description: A quality solution for top-tier waterproofing, Poseidon Liquid Applied Waterproof Membrane is a polymer-based, VOC-free, liquid membrane that offers remarkable flexibility, creating a reliable and resilient barrier once applied to protect your spaces. Ideal for use in bathrooms, steam areas, and wet rooms before tiling, Poseidon ensures your surfaces remain impervious to moisture.Incorporating Poseidon into your project means a complete vapour block, eliminating the need for corner reinforcements and simplifying your waterproofing process. Versatile in application, you can choose between a brush, roller, or an airless paint spray machine to achieve professional-grade results without the usual hassle.Features & Benefits: Poseidon Liquid Applied Waterproof MembraneA quality VOC-free polymer-based liquid barrier for top-tier waterproofingIdeal for ensuring moisture resistance in bathrooms and wet rooms before tilingCreates a complete vapour block, eliminating the need for corner reinforcementsEasy to apply using a brush, roller, or airless paint spray machineBlue colour makes it easy to identify treated areasBoasts crack bridging capability, protecting concrete and cement-based surfaces1.2kg per square meter coverageWith its eye-catching blue colour, Poseidon stands out, making it easy to identify treated areas. Poseidon's advanced design ensures that corner reinforcements are unnecessary, saving you both time and effort.Please note: Avoid any contact with water or other liquids during the drying phase.You should always clean your equipment after use with cold water.Ensure ventilation in case of high humidity.Do not apply on bitumen or asphalt-containing surfaces or surfaces with continuous water contact or water pressure. product.name: The GOAT Concrete and Masonry Waterproof Coating
product.description: This Concrete and Masonry Waterproof Coating is a cutting-edge coating offering easy application and quick drying times. It is a reactive polymer-based solution designed to redefine waterproofing in construction and is ideal for a diverse range of applications. It's perfect for safeguarding structures in concrete or masonry, including basement walls, basement roofs, foundations, terraces, balconies, and pipe penetrations. Its superior adhesion extends to various building materials, such as concrete blocks, bricks, concrete, plastics, metals, polypropylene, polyethylene, and PVC-U, ensuring a secure and long-lasting waterproof barrier. Application is quick and simple, thanks to the option of using a brush or a roller, which allows you to create a waterproof and flexible membrane with minimal fuss.Features & Benefits: The GOAT Concrete and Masonry Waterproof CoatingAn easy-to-apply, quick-drying concrete and masonry waterproof coatingSuperior adhesion to various building materials, including concrete blocks, plastics, metals, and moreEasy application with a brush or roller for a flexible, UV-resistant membraneSuitable for damp surfaces and both horizontal and vertical projectsResistant to freeze-thaw cycles, providing durability in harsh conditionsEnvironmentally friendly with VOC and solvent-free formulaFree of harmful isocyanatesThis membrane not only exhibits excellent adhesion to various surfaces but it also boasts remarkable UV resistance, ensuring your structures remain protected even when exposed to the sun's UV rays. It can be applied on damp surfaces, and whether your project involves horizontal or vertical surfaces, this waterproof coating is up to the task. It can even withstand both positive and negative water pressure, providing versatility that's hard to beat.Further enhancing its reliability, this coating is resistant to freeze-thaw cycles, ensuring long-lasting protection in harsh weather conditions. Its environmental credentials are equally impressive, with a VOC and solvent-free formulation, and it's completely free of isocyanates, eliminating any potential harm to users and the environment.

The Skyline aluminium coping range has been designed for use with Alumasc's aluminium gutter and rainwater systems, to create a complete eaves and roof drainage system that works together efficiently and precisely.Features & Benefits: Alumasc Skyline Aluminium Fixing StrapStrong, easy-to-use snap-fix systemEco-friendly and made from 100% recycled aluminiumLong life expectancyThe copings are installed with a strapping method, consisting of a fixing strap profile that has an integral EPDM seal. This means there is no penetration required, which helps to improve weathertightness and allows ventilation over the top of the wall. While the strap fixing provides rigidity and strength, the modern design ensures the fixings are not visible, which makes for an aesthetically appealing style suitable for a range of projects.

product.name: Alumasc Skyline SF1 Profile Fascia with 1 Bend - 3000mm Length
product.description: This aluminium fascia board system fully encompasses your gutters, combining modern design and aesthetic sensibilities with high-quality materials. The 'Skyline' range is compatible with the Alumasc aluminium rainwater systems for a complete eaves drainage solution. Made to measure in a range of sizes, these fascias have mitred and welded edges to create a smooth finish. This variant is an SF1 profile unit with a single bend.Using proprietary manufacturing processes, these Skyline fascia boards use BBA-approved polyester powder coatings and durable, non-corrosive aluminium. An ideal combination for soffit planks to give eaves differing overhangs or projecting directly from the elevation, this fascia can be jointed with internal brackets; no stepping joints needed. With an impressive 40-year life expectancy in rural/suburban areas and 25 years in more challenging industrial and marine areas, this fascia is highly versatile. Excelling in commercial, industrial, healthcare, residential and public sector buildings, these fascias require minimal maintenance once installed.Features & Benefits: Alumasc Skyline SF1 Profile Fascia with 1 Bend - 3000mm LengthFully compatible with the Alumasc other aluminium rainwater systemsMitred and welded edges for a consistent smooth finishJointed using internal brackets without stepping jointsSF1 profile with one bendMade from robust, non-corrodible aluminium with minimal maintenance requirements and a long life expectancyCoated black RAL9017m with BBA certified polyester powder coatingsLightweight and 100% recyclable aluminium materialUK manufacturedAvailable in a range of sizes to fit your building needs

product.name: Alumasc Skyline Aluminium 90 Degree Corner
product.description: The Alumasc Skyline range of aluminium coping consists of a number of coping products for use at roofing and gutter interfaces. The Skyline aluminium coping range has been designed for use with Alumasc's aluminium gutter and rainwater systems to create a complete eaves and roof drainage system that works together efficiently and precisely, creating a cohesive appearance.The 90 degree corner allows the coping to be fitted cleanly and accurately around any 90 degree bends within the upstanding parapet, wall or flat roof perimeter. The 90 degree corner is installed similarly to the rest of the coping products. A fixing strap profile with integral EPDM seal is used to create a weatherproof coating, ensuring no penetration of the coping is required and helping to maintain the weatherproof characteristics.Features & Benefits: Alumasc Skyline Aluminium 90 Degree CornerEco-friendly, durable, and long-lastingLightweight, fully recycled aluminium constructionIntegral EPDM seal ensures a weatherproof coatingThe Skyline range of aluminium copings has been designed as an economical and easily installed cap that sits on upstanding parapets, or in conjunction with flat or pitched roofs. The aluminium copings are extremely lightweight, which improves the installation time, whilst also being durable and non-corrodible, helping to maximise the lifespan and resulting in minimal maintenance. As a result, the aluminium coping has a lifespan of 40 years in rural or suburban areas, and up to 25 years in industrial or marine areas.

product.name: Alumasc Skyline Aluminium Coping
product.description: Providing an economical and easily installed capping to upstand parapets in conjunction with pitched roofs or flats, this Skyline Coping uses a strap fixing method, providing a fully weatherproof covering without penetrating the skyline coping. This coping also allows for ventilation over the top of the wall.Equally suited to new and existing buildings, refurbishment and retrofit projects, this coping is ideal for a variety of sectors including commercial, healthcare, residential and public sectors. With fixings not visible on the surface, this coping maintains attractive and clean lines with excellent rigidity from the material thickness and fixing mechanism. Made from durable, non-corrodible and lightweight aluminium, this standard flat coping is quick and simple to install with minimal maintenance requirements. In most circumstances, this coping can be fixed from the roof without required external access making it particularly suitable for renovation work.Features & Benefits: Alumasc Skyline Aluminium CopingProvides a completely weatherproof covering to upstand parapets as the fixing method does not penetrate the skyline coping  Quick and simple to install with minimal maintenance requirements  Skyline standard flat coping available in a range of widths  UK manufactured  Sustainable, environmentally friendly and 100% recyclable aluminium  Available in a wide range of colours with BBA approved polyester powder coatings  Made from robust, non-corrosive and lightweight aluminium with a long life expectancyMade from infinitely recyclable aluminium, this coping has a life expectancy of 40 years in rural/suburban areas and up to 25 years in industrial/marine areas. Fabricated from a 2mm or 3mm thick aluminium alloy sheet, depending on the wall thickness, this coping is available in a range of widths to fit your building requirements and is mitred and welded to give a smooth finish on the front face. You have a large variety of colours to choose from with a BBA approved process for factory-applied polyester powder coatings.Please note: This coping has a coefficient of linear thermal expansion of 23 x 10-6mm/m/°C and requires a gap of 3-4mm between sections to accommodate for thermal expansion.  This aluminium coping needs a waterproof membrane underneath to provide an effective seal.

This coping also allows for ventilation over the top of the wall.Equally suited to new and existing buildings, refurbishment and retrofit projects, this coping is ideal for a variety of sectors including commercial, healthcare, residential and public sectors. With fixings not visible on the surface, this coping maintains attractive and clean lines with excellent rigidity from the material thickness and fixing mechanism. Made from durable, non-corrodible and lightweight aluminium, this standard flat coping is quick and simple to install with minimal maintenance requirements. In most circumstances, this coping can be fixed from the roof without required external access making it particularly suitable for renovation work.Features & Benefits: Alumasc Skyline Aluminium CopingProvides a completely weatherproof covering to upstand parapets as the fixing method does not penetrate the skyline coping  Quick and simple to install with minimal maintenance requirements  Skyline standard flat coping available in a range of widths  UK manufactured  Sustainable, environmentally friendly and 100% recyclable aluminium  Available in a wide range of colours with BBA approved polyester powder coatings  Made from robust, non-corrosive and lightweight aluminium with a long life expectancyMade from infinitely recyclable aluminium, this coping has a life expectancy of 40 years in rural/suburban areas and up to 25 years in industrial/marine areas. Fabricated from a 2mm or 3mm thick aluminium alloy sheet, depending on the wall thickness, this coping is available in a range of widths to fit your building requirements and is mitred and welded to give a smooth finish on the front face. You have a large variety of colours to choose from with a BBA approved process for factory-applied polyester powder coatings.Please note: This coping has a coefficient of linear thermal expansion of 23 x 10-6mm/m/°C and requires a gap of 3-4mm between sections to accommodate for thermal expansion.  This aluminium coping needs a waterproof membrane underneath to provide an effective seal.

product.description: Providing an economical and easily installed capping to upstand parapets in conjunction with pitched roofs or flats, this Skyline Coping uses a strap fixing method, providing a fully weatherproof covering without penetrating the skyline coping. This coping also allows for ventilation over the top of the wall.Equally suited to new and existing buildings, refurbishment and retrofit projects, this coping is ideal for a variety of sectors including commercial, healthcare, residential and public sectors. With fixings not visible on the surface, this coping maintains attractive and clean lines with excellent rigidity from the material thickness and fixing mechanism. Made from durable, non-corrodible and lightweight aluminium, this standard flat coping is quick and simple to install with minimal maintenance requirements. In most circumstances, this coping can be fixed from the roof without required external access making it particularly suitable for renovation work.Features & Benefits: Alumasc Skyline Aluminium CopingProvides a completely weatherproof covering to upstand parapets as the fixing method does not penetrate the skyline coping  Quick and simple to install with minimal maintenance requirements  Skyline standard flat coping available in a range of widths  UK manufactured  Sustainable, environmentally friendly and 100% recyclable aluminium  Available in a wide range of colours with BBA approved polyester powder coatings  Made from robust, non-corrosive and lightweight aluminium with a long life expectancyMade from infinitely recyclable aluminium, this coping has a life expectancy of 40 years in rural/suburban areas and up to 25 years in industrial/marine areas. Fabricated from a 2mm or 3mm thick aluminium alloy sheet, depending on the wall thickness, this coping is available in a range of widths to fit your building requirements and is mitred and welded to give a smooth finish on the front face. You have a large variety of colours to choose from with a BBA approved process for factory-applied polyester powder coatings.Please note: This coping has a coefficient of linear thermal expansion of 23 x 10-6mm/m/°C and requires a gap of 3-4mm between sections to accommodate for thermal expansion.  This aluminium coping needs a waterproof membrane underneath to provide an effective seal.

product.description: Providing an economical and easily installed capping to upstand parapets in conjunction with pitched roofs or flats, this Skyline Coping uses a strap fixing method, providing a fully weatherproof covering without penetrating the skyline coping. This coping also allows for ventilation over the top of the wall.Equally suited to new and existing buildings, refurbishment and retrofit projects, this coping is ideal for a variety of sectors including commercial, healthcare, residential and public sectors. With fixings not visible on the surface, this coping maintains attractive and clean lines with excellent rigidity from the material thickness and fixing mechanism. Made from durable, non-corrodible and lightweight aluminium, this standard flat coping is quick and simple to install with minimal maintenance requirements. In most circumstances, this coping can be fixed from the roof without required external access making it particularly suitable for renovation work.Features & Benefits: Alumasc Skyline Aluminium CopingProvides a completely weatherproof covering to upstand parapets as the fixing method does not penetrate the skyline coping  Quick and simple to install with minimal maintenance requirements  Skyline standard flat coping available in a range of widths  UK manufactured  Sustainable, environmentally friendly and 100% recyclable aluminium  Available in a wide range of colours with BBA approved polyester powder coatings  Made from robust, non-corrosive and lightweight aluminium with a long life expectancyMade from infinitely recyclable aluminium, this coping has a life expectancy of 40 years in rural/suburban areas and up to 25 years in industrial/marine areas. Fabricated from a 2mm or 3mm thick aluminium alloy sheet, depending on the wall thickness, this coping is available in a range of widths to fit your building requirements and is mitred and welded to give a smooth finish on the front face. You have a large variety of colours to choose from with a BBA approved process for factory-applied polyester powder coatings.Please note: This coping has a coefficient of linear thermal expansion of 23 x 10-6mm/m/°C and requires a gap of 3-4mm between sections to accommodate for thermal expansion.  This aluminium coping needs a waterproof membrane underneath to provide an effective seal.

This coping also allows for ventilation over the top of the wall.Equally suited to new and existing buildings, refurbishment and retrofit projects, this coping is ideal for a variety of sectors including commercial, healthcare, residential and public sectors. With fixings not visible on the surface, this coping maintains attractive and clean lines with excellent rigidity from the material thickness and fixing mechanism. Made from durable, non-corrodible and lightweight aluminium, this standard flat coping is quick and simple to install with minimal maintenance requirements. In most circumstances, this coping can be fixed from the roof without required external access making it particularly suitable for renovation work.Features & Benefits: Alumasc Skyline Aluminium CopingProvides a completely weatherproof covering to upstand parapets as the fixing method does not penetrate the skyline coping  Quick and simple to install with minimal maintenance requirements  Skyline standard flat coping available in a range of widths  UK manufactured  Sustainable, environmentally friendly and 100% recyclable aluminium  Available in a wide range of colours with BBA approved polyester powder coatings  Made from robust, non-corrosive and lightweight aluminium with a long life expectancyMade from infinitely recyclable aluminium, this coping has a life expectancy of 40 years in rural/suburban areas and up to 25 years in industrial/marine areas. Fabricated from a 2mm or 3mm thick aluminium alloy sheet, depending on the wall thickness, this coping is available in a range of widths to fit your building requirements and is mitred and welded to give a smooth finish on the front face. You have a large variety of colours to choose from with a BBA approved process for factory-applied polyester powder coatings.Please note: This coping has a coefficient of linear thermal expansion of 23 x 10-6mm/m/°C and requires a gap of 3-4mm between sections to accommodate for thermal expansion.  This aluminium coping needs a waterproof membrane underneath to provide an effective seal.

product.description: Providing an economical and easily installed capping to upstand parapets in conjunction with pitched roofs or flats, this Skyline Coping uses a strap fixing method, providing a fully weatherproof covering without penetrating the skyline coping. This coping also allows for ventilation over the top of the wall.Equally suited to new and existing buildings, refurbishment and retrofit projects, this coping is ideal for a variety of sectors including commercial, healthcare, residential and public sectors. With fixings not visible on the surface, this coping maintains attractive and clean lines with excellent rigidity from the material thickness and fixing mechanism. Made from durable, non-corrodible and lightweight aluminium, this standard flat coping is quick and simple to install with minimal maintenance requirements. In most circumstances, this coping can be fixed from the roof without required external access making it particularly suitable for renovation work.Features & Benefits: Alumasc Skyline Aluminium CopingProvides a completely weatherproof covering to upstand parapets as the fixing method does not penetrate the skyline coping  Quick and simple to install with minimal maintenance requirements  Skyline standard flat coping available in a range of widths  UK manufactured  Sustainable, environmentally friendly and 100% recyclable aluminium  Available in a wide range of colours with BBA approved polyester powder coatings  Made from robust, non-corrosive and lightweight aluminium with a long life expectancyMade from infinitely recyclable aluminium, this coping has a life expectancy of 40 years in rural/suburban areas and up to 25 years in industrial/marine areas. Fabricated from a 2mm or 3mm thick aluminium alloy sheet, depending on the wall thickness, this coping is available in a range of widths to fit your building requirements and is mitred and welded to give a smooth finish on the front face. You have a large variety of colours to choose from with a BBA approved process for factory-applied polyester powder coatings.Please note: This coping has a coefficient of linear thermal expansion of 23 x 10-6mm/m/°C and requires a gap of 3-4mm between sections to accommodate for thermal expansion.  This aluminium coping needs a waterproof membrane underneath to provide an effective seal.

product.name: Alumasc Skyline Aluminium Coping
product.description: Providing an economical and easily installed capping to upstand parapets in conjunction with pitched roofs or flats, this Skyline Coping uses a strap fixing method, providing a fully weatherproof covering without penetrating the skyline coping. This coping also allows for ventilation over the top of the wall.Equally suited to new and existing buildings, refurbishment and retrofit projects, this coping is ideal for a variety of sectors including commercial, healthcare, residential and public sectors. With fixings not visible on the surface, this coping maintains attractive and clean lines with excellent rigidity from the material thickness and fixing mechanism. Made from durable, non-corrodible and lightweight aluminium, this standard flat coping is quick and simple to install with minimal maintenance requirements. In most circumstances, this coping can be fixed from the roof without required external access making it particularly suitable for renovation work.Features & Benefits: Alumasc Skyline Aluminium CopingProvides a completely weatherproof covering to upstand parapets as the fixing method does not penetrate the skyline coping  Quick and simple to install with minimal maintenance requirements  Skyline standard flat coping available in a range of widths  UK manufactured  Sustainable, environmentally friendly and 100% recyclable aluminium  Available in a wide range of colours with BBA approved polyester powder coatings  Made from robust, non-corrosive and lightweight aluminium with a long life expectancyMade from infinitely recyclable aluminium, this coping has a life expectancy of 40 years in rural/suburban areas and up to 25 years in industrial/marine areas. Fabricated from a 2mm or 3mm thick aluminium alloy sheet, depending on the wall thickness, this coping is available in a range of widths to fit your building requirements and is mitred and welded to give a smooth finish on the front face. You have a large variety of colours to choose from with a BBA approved process for factory-applied polyester powder coatings.Please note: This coping has a coefficient of linear thermal expansion of 23 x 10-6mm/m/°C and requires a gap of 3-4mm between sections to accommodate for thermal expansion.  This aluminium coping needs a waterproof membrane underneath to provide an effective seal.

product.description: Providing an economical and easily installed capping to upstand parapets in conjunction with pitched roofs or flats, this Skyline Coping uses a strap fixing method, providing a fully weatherproof covering without penetrating the skyline coping. This coping also allows for ventilation over the top of the wall.Equally suited to new and existing buildings, refurbishment and retrofit projects, this coping is ideal for a variety of sectors including commercial, healthcare, residential and public sectors. With fixings not visible on the surface, this coping maintains attractive and clean lines with excellent rigidity from the material thickness and fixing mechanism. Made from durable, non-corrodible and lightweight aluminium, this standard flat coping is quick and simple to install with minimal maintenance requirements. In most circumstances, this coping can be fixed from the roof without required external access making it particularly suitable for renovation work.Features & Benefits: Alumasc Skyline Aluminium CopingProvides a completely weatherproof covering to upstand parapets as the fixing method does not penetrate the skyline coping  Quick and simple to install with minimal maintenance requirements  Skyline standard flat coping available in a range of widths  UK manufactured  Sustainable, environmentally friendly and 100% recyclable aluminium  Available in a wide range of colours with BBA approved polyester powder coatings  Made from robust, non-corrosive and lightweight aluminium with a long life expectancyMade from infinitely recyclable aluminium, this coping has a life expectancy of 40 years in rural/suburban areas and up to 25 years in industrial/marine areas. Fabricated from a 2mm or 3mm thick aluminium alloy sheet, depending on the wall thickness, this coping is available in a range of widths to fit your building requirements and is mitred and welded to give a smooth finish on the front face. You have a large variety of colours to choose from with a BBA approved process for factory-applied polyester powder coatings.Please note: This coping has a coefficient of linear thermal expansion of 23 x 10-6mm/m/°C and requires a gap of 3-4mm between sections to accommodate for thermal expansion.  This aluminium coping needs a waterproof membrane underneath to provide an effective seal.

product.description: Providing an economical and easily installed capping to upstand parapets in conjunction with pitched roofs or flats, this Skyline Coping uses a strap fixing method, providing a fully weatherproof covering without penetrating the skyline coping. This coping also allows for ventilation over the top of the wall.Equally suited to new and existing buildings, refurbishment and retrofit projects, this coping is ideal for a variety of sectors including commercial, healthcare, residential and public sectors. With fixings not visible on the surface, this coping maintains attractive and clean lines with excellent rigidity from the material thickness and fixing mechanism. Made from durable, non-corrodible and lightweight aluminium, this standard flat coping is quick and simple to install with minimal maintenance requirements. In most circumstances, this coping can be fixed from the roof without required external access making it particularly suitable for renovation work.Features & Benefits: Alumasc Skyline Aluminium CopingProvides a completely weatherproof covering to upstand parapets as the fixing method does not penetrate the skyline coping  Quick and simple to install with minimal maintenance requirements  Skyline standard flat coping available in a range of widths  UK manufactured  Sustainable, environmentally friendly and 100% recyclable aluminium  Available in a wide range of colours with BBA approved polyester powder coatings  Made from robust, non-corrosive and lightweight aluminium with a long life expectancyMade from infinitely recyclable aluminium, this coping has a life expectancy of 40 years in rural/suburban areas and up to 25 years in industrial/marine areas. Fabricated from a 2mm or 3mm thick aluminium alloy sheet, depending on the wall thickness, this coping is available in a range of widths to fit your building requirements and is mitred and welded to give a smooth finish on the front face. You have a large variety of colours to choose from with a BBA approved process for factory-applied polyester powder coatings.Please note: This coping has a coefficient of linear thermal expansion of 23 x 10-6mm/m/°C and requires a gap of 3-4mm between sections to accommodate for thermal expansion.  This aluminium coping needs a waterproof membrane underneath to provide an effective seal.

product.description: Providing an economical and easily installed capping to upstand parapets in conjunction with pitched roofs or flats, this Skyline Coping uses a strap fixing method, providing a fully weatherproof covering without penetrating the skyline coping. This coping also allows for ventilation over the top of the wall.Equally suited to new and existing buildings, refurbishment and retrofit projects, this coping is ideal for a variety of sectors including commercial, healthcare, residential and public sectors. With fixings not visible on the surface, this coping maintains attractive and clean lines with excellent rigidity from the material thickness and fixing mechanism. Made from durable, non-corrodible and lightweight aluminium, this standard flat coping is quick and simple to install with minimal maintenance requirements. In most circumstances, this coping can be fixed from the roof without required external access making it particularly suitable for renovation work.Features & Benefits: Alumasc Skyline Aluminium CopingProvides a completely weatherproof covering to upstand parapets as the fixing method does not penetrate the skyline coping  Quick and simple to install with minimal maintenance requirements  Skyline standard flat coping available in a range of widths  UK manufactured  Sustainable, environmentally friendly and 100% recyclable aluminium  Available in a wide range of colours with BBA approved polyester powder coatings  Made from robust, non-corrosive and lightweight aluminium with a long life expectancyMade from infinitely recyclable aluminium, this coping has a life expectancy of 40 years in rural/suburban areas and up to 25 years in industrial/marine areas. Fabricated from a 2mm or 3mm thick aluminium alloy sheet, depending on the wall thickness, this coping is available in a range of widths to fit your building requirements and is mitred and welded to give a smooth finish on the front face. You have a large variety of colours to choose from with a BBA approved process for factory-applied polyester powder coatings.Please note: This coping has a coefficient of linear thermal expansion of 23 x 10-6mm/m/°C and requires a gap of 3-4mm between sections to accommodate for thermal expansion.  This aluminium coping needs a waterproof membrane underneath to provide an effective seal.

This coping also allows for ventilation over the top of the wall.Equally suited to new and existing buildings, refurbishment and retrofit projects, this coping is ideal for a variety of sectors including commercial, healthcare, residential and public sectors. With fixings not visible on the surface, this coping maintains attractive and clean lines with excellent rigidity from the material thickness and fixing mechanism. Made from durable, non-corrodible and lightweight aluminium, this standard flat coping is quick and simple to install with minimal maintenance requirements. In most circumstances, this coping can be fixed from the roof without required external access making it particularly suitable for renovation work.Features & Benefits: Alumasc Skyline Aluminium CopingProvides a completely weatherproof covering to upstand parapets as the fixing method does not penetrate the skyline coping  Quick and simple to install with minimal maintenance requirements  Skyline standard flat coping available in a range of widths  UK manufactured  Sustainable, environmentally friendly and 100% recyclable aluminium  Available in a wide range of colours with BBA approved polyester powder coatings  Made from robust, non-corrosive and lightweight aluminium with a long life expectancyMade from infinitely recyclable aluminium, this coping has a life expectancy of 40 years in rural/suburban areas and up to 25 years in industrial/marine areas. Fabricated from a 2mm or 3mm thick aluminium alloy sheet, depending on the wall thickness, this coping is available in a range of widths to fit your building requirements and is mitred and welded to give a smooth finish on the front face. You have a large variety of colours to choose from with a BBA approved process for factory-applied polyester powder coatings.Please note: This coping has a coefficient of linear thermal expansion of 23 x 10-6mm/m/°C and requires a gap of 3-4mm between sections to accommodate for thermal expansion.  This aluminium coping needs a waterproof membrane underneath to provide an effective seal.
product.variant_name: Alumasc Skyline Aluminium Coping in Agate Grey - 422mm x 2000mm

product.name: Alumasc Skyline SF7 Profile Fascia Internal Corner with 7 Bends
product.description:
This Alumasc Skyline Fascia Internal Corner with seven bends, which is also known as an SF7 profile, has been designed to work with the Alumasc guttering system.
The Alumasc Skyline fascia system has been manufactured from high quality, polyester powder coated aluminium to provide you with a strong, durable, and long-lasting product. As well as this, the fascia profiles will fully enclose the gutter and they can be projected direct from the elevation or combined with the soffit plan to give varying eaves overhangs.
The Alumasc fascias are also fully compatible with Alumasc gutters and they provide a combined eaves drainage solution.
Suitable for new build roofs, you can complete the perimeter design by using the Alumasc fascias. The linear components are joined by internal brackets which can be used to avoid stepped joints. As well as this, fabricated fittings are mitred and welded to create a smooth finish.
Aluminium has a life expectancy of an excess of 40 years in rural and suburban areas and up to 25 years in industrial and/or marine conditions. This makes aluminium the perfect material to a variety of applications with no limitations. In addition to this, Alumasc aluminium fascias contain no toxic substances and they perform excellently when assessed from cradle to grave for effects on water quality and water/ground contamination.
Features & Benefits

Seven bends
SF7 profile
Compatible with Alumasc guttering
Fully encloses gutter
Suitable for new builds
Completes new build roof perimeter designs
Provides a combined eaves drainage solution
Linear components jointed by internal brackets, avoiding stepped joints
Fabricated fittings are mitred, welded and have a smooth finish

product.name: Alumasc Skyline SOF7 Profile Soffit External Corner with 7 Bends
product.description:
This Alumasc Skyline Soffit External Corner with seven bends, which is also known as an SOF7 profile, is manufactured from durable polyester powder coated aluminium and has been designed to work with the Alumasc guttering system.
Alumasc Skyline Soffit Planks are a secret fix modular planking system which has been designed to work on overhanging soffits and canopies. They can be used as part of the Skyline fascia scheme, allowing you to create an aesthetically pleasing finish by matching the soffits to the colour of the facias. Whilst creating a seamless look, soffits protect and conceal rafters from both environmental factors, and they prevent animals from entering the roofing space. Their protection also reduces the risk of mould forming and damaging the rafters.
The Alumasc soffits are also fully compatible with Alumasc gutters and they provide a combined eaves drainage solution.
Suitable for new build roofs, you can complete the perimeter design by using the Alumasc soffits. The linear components are joined by internal brackets which can be used to avoid stepped joints. As well as this, fabricated fittings are mitred and welded to create a smooth finish.
Aluminium has a life expectancy of an excess of 40 years in rural and suburban areas and up to 25 years in industrial and/or marine conditions. This makes aluminium the perfect material to a variety of applications with no limitations. In addition to this, Alumasc aluminium soffits contain no toxic substances and they perform excellently when assessed from cradle to grave for effects on water quality and water/ground contamination.
Features & Benefits

Seven bends
SOF7 profile
Compatible with Alumasc guttering
Fully encloses gutter
Suitable for new builds
Completes new build roof perimeter designs
Provides a combined eaves drainage solution
Linear components jointed by internal brackets, avoiding stepped joints
Fabricated fittings are mitred, welded and have a smooth finish

product.name: RynoDeck RDF Fixed-Head Adjustable Decking Pedestal
product.description: Made from recycled polypropylene that is fantastically resistant to bitumen, algae, alkali and mould, this RDF fixed-head adjustable decking pedestal from RynoDeck is durable and resilient. Perfect for various types of decking and floor joists in -30°C to 120°C temperatures, the pedestal can withstand up to 1000kg compression.Without shims, the fixed-head pedestal makes height adjustments and corrections between 22mm and 550mm. product.description: This EasyFlash® flashing is universal and lightweight and can be used for the sealing of abutments between roof tiles and walls and for connections on a pitched roof either for penetrations through the roof or other areas. This EasyFlash® can be worked and installed to professional standards with basic tools including scissors, pencil and ruler. This flashing is manufactured from a highly flexible material, up to 60%, thanks to its creped aluminium structure. This aluminium exterior ensures that it is effortlessly mouldable to the contours of your roof and is especially effective at the corners, fitting tightly and permanently.Features & Benefits: EasyFlash Lead Grey Lead Alternative Flashing - 5000mmLightweight, universal flashingRange of widths availableHighly flexible with creped aluminium structureEasily mouldableDurable butyl undersideUnaffected by wind upliftSelf-fusing propertiesProvides good security against penetrationCompatible with all plain and profiled roofing materials10-year guarantee against manufacturing defectThe self-fusing qualities of the material remove the need for glueing and soldering while the sealed edge helps to provide great protection against dust, snow and rain penetration. With a butyl underside, it is incredibly durable and unaffected by any wind uplift. Suitable applications include chimneys, rising parts of structures such as firewalls, dormers and other abutments in the roof area, refurbishment or new build projects and all abutments at walls. This EasyFlash® is adaptable to all profiled and plain roofing materials.

product.name: Wakaflex Anthracite Alternative Lead Flashing - 5000mm
product.description: Designed to replace lead in most contemporary roofing applications, this 5000mm Wakaflex® Anthracite Alternative Lead Flashing is BBA-certified, flexible, lead-free and adhesive. It has multiple advantages compared to traditional lead flashings when working in the construction industry, including the quick and straightforward installation process and being made from a lightweight, non-toxic material.Used for an array of applications such as rising parts of structures like dormers, chimneys and all abutments at walls, this Wakaflex® flashing is suitable for use on a roof with a minimum pitch of the tile up to a maximum of 90°. Effortless to apply with excellent stretchability in both directions, it has a unique product composition with a self-welding effect.Features & Benefits: Wakaflex Anthracite Alternative Lead Flashing - 5000mmPolyisobuthylene (PIB) material with aluminium meshwork and butyl-adhesive tapeAnthracite colourFlexible with excellent stretchabilityLead-free and non-toxicLightweight, quick and easy to installAdhesive with self-welding effect5000mm length with a range of widths availableSuitable for roof pitches up to 90°BBA certified10-year guarantee against manufacturing defectFor a secure fit, laps should be at least 50mm. Utilise a roller to apply consistent pressure, ensuring a snug result. Lay Wakaflex® exclusively on surfaces that are dry, dust-free and free from oils, guaranteeing optimal adhesion and longevity. For robust integration into brickwork, turn into joints or chase in by at least 30mm. In the case of larger or uneven joints, create a welt at the back and seal it with a reliable sealant. Strategically fold strips of Wakaflex® as wedges into brickwork before sealing with a trusted sealant to secure the flashing in place.At top edge abutments, cover slates with Wakaflex® by a minimum of 150mm, turning up the wall by 75mm. Secure it in brickwork joints. At mansards, extend over slates on the lower roof by at least 150mm. Secure with a lay board and tilting fillet on the upper roof, extending the flashing 150-200mm up the slope. Nail into position at the top at approximately 150mm intervals. This flashing is suited for use as saddles, ridge/wall junctions, fixing around roof outlets or with Wakaflex®’s top edge abutment ventilator.Please note: Wakaflex® must not be installed such that ponding can occur.Wakaflex® is not compatible with bituminous material.Fixing instructions for use around chimneys are available.

product.name: Westwood SLA Barrier Pipe for Contaminated Ground
product.description: Equipped with push-fit fittings for easy installation without additional wrapping, this Westwood SLA Barrier Pipe is ideal for safe water distribution where contaminated ground is present. With its multi-layer construction, the pipe consists of a 25mm black PE100 inner core, a middle layer of double-bonded aluminium and an outer layer of blue PE100 featuring brown identification stripes and extra protection.While the inner black PE layer and outer blue PE layer allow for easy identification and make any damage to the pipe during installation apparent, the inclusion of the middle aluminium layer serves to effectively block the infiltration of heavy metals, inorganic substances, and hydrocarbons from the ground into drinking water supplies. This way, it ensures the safe transportation of potable water even through contaminated land.Features & Benefits: Westwood SLA Barrier Pipe for Contaminated GroundPush-fit fittings for easy installation without additional wrappingWorking pressure of up to 16 bar (tested to 24 bar in test conditions) with water temperatures up to 20°CPermits safe water distribution in areas with contaminated groundFor use with push-fit SLA Barrier Pipe fittingsStandards & CertificationWIS 4-39-19 (only use push-fit SLA Barrier Pipe fittings), WRAS and DWI Regulation 31 approvedMeets BS EN 12201Independent chemical and mechanical testing performed by KIWAPlease note: Gunmetal and electrofusion fittings may be used with 25mm barrier pipe, however push-fit fittings are recommended.
